
===== statusDefinitions =====
人」。'
};
const STATUS_BASIS_DETAILS={
  fixed:'固定數值：係數本身就是每次結算的原始點數。',
  casterAttack:'施法者攻擊力：我方施法者讀目前 battleStats.atk，因此會包含當下攻擊提升；再乘係數。',
  casterMaxHp:'施法者最大生命：讀施法者目前最大生命，再乘係數。',
  casterCurrentHp:'施法者當前生命：每次結算當下重新讀取，不鎖定施放瞬間數值。',
  casterMissingHp:'施法者已損生命：每次結算以「最大生命－當前生命」重新計算。',
  casterDefense:'施法者防禦：我方施法者讀目前 battleStats.def，再乘係數。',
  casterShield:'施法者護盾：讀普通 shield 欄位；變形護盾是獨立控制資料，不算在此係數。',
  casterLevel:'施法者等級：以目前等級直接乘係數。',
  targetAttack:'目標攻擊力：我方目標讀 battleStats.atk；敵方讀原始 atk，因此 weaken 不會降低此係數基準。',
  targetMaxHp:'目標最大生命：每次結算讀目前最大生命，再乘係數。',
  targetCurrentHp:'目標當前生命：每次結算當下重新讀取，會隨前一段傷害／恢復改變。',
  targetMissingHp:'目標已損生命：每次結算依當下缺血量重新計算。',
  targetDefense:'目標防禦：我方讀 battleStats.def；敵方讀原始 def（破甲／防無／防穿屬於後續傷害結算，不會先改寫此係數基準）。',
  targetShield:'目標護盾：讀普通 shield 欄位；敵方變形護盾不屬於這個欄位。',
  targetLevel:'目標等級：以目前等級直接乘係數。'
};
const STATUS_TARGETS=['enemy','enemies','self','weakest','allies'];
const STATUS_TARGET_LABELS={enemy:'目前敵人',enemies:'敵方全體',self:'自己',weakest:'生命比例最低隊友',allies:'我方全體'};
const STATUS_HERO_ONLY_MODIFIERS=new Set(['attack','critical','guard','power','regen']);
const STATUS_ENEMY_ONLY_MODIFIERS=new Set(['fracture','weaken','vulnerable','damageAmp','followup']);
function statusAllowedTargetsForDefinition(def){
  if(!def)return STATUS_TARGETS.slice();
  const heroOnly=def.modifiers.some(m=>STATUS_HERO_ONLY_MODIFIERS.has(m.kind))||def.periodic.some(fx=>fx.kind==='heal'&&fx.resolution==='overflowShield'),enemyOnly=!!def.control||def.modifiers.some(m=>STATUS_ENEMY_ONLY_MODIFIERS.has(m.kind));
  if(heroOnly&&enemyOnly)return [];
  if(heroOnly)return ['self','weakest','allies'];
  if(enemyOnly)return ['enemy','enemies'];
  return STATUS_TARGETS.slice();
}
let selectedStatusIndex=0;
const deepCloneStatus=v=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
function statusList(){
  const list=data.statusDefinitions=Array.isArray(data.statusDefinitions)?data.statusDefinitions:[];
  list.forEach((x,i)=>{
    const normalized=normalizeStatusDefinition(x,i);
    // Preserve references held by editor events when the definition is already normalized.
    if(JSON.stringify(x)!==JSON.stringify(normalized))list[i]=normalized;
  });
  return list;
}
function nextStatusId(){const used=new Set(statusList().map(x=>x.id));let n=1;while(used.has('status-'+n))n++;return 'status-'+n;}
function labelOptions(list,labels,value){return list.map(x=>'<option value="'+esc(x)+'" '+(x===value?'selected':'')+'>'+esc(labels[x]||x)+'</option>').join('');}
function statusPeriodicRuleText(fx){return (STATUS_BASIS_DETAILS[fx.basis]||'')+' '+(STATUS_RESOLUTION_DETAILS[fx.resolution]||'');}
function statusModifierRuleText(m){return STATUS_MODIFIER_DETAILS[m.kind]||'';}
function statusControlRuleText(c){return c?STATUS_CONTROL_DETAILS[c.kind]||'':'';}
function statusRuleGuideHtml(){
  const resolutionOrder=['fixed','defended','elemental','true','heal','overflowShield'];
  return '<details class="card status-maker-guide"><summary>完整判定規則：傷害／恢復、增減益與控制</summary><div class="status-maker-guide-grid">'+
    '<div class="status-maker-guide-item status-maker-guide-wide"><b>共同規則</b><p>持續效果每個戰鬥回合最多結算一次；「立即行動」只是在套用瞬間額外結算一次，不會少掉後續完整持續次數。同一狀態由同一施法者重新套到同一目標時刷新，不疊成兩份。除受擊追打外，自訂持續傷害不視為一般命中，因此不觸發 on-hit／受擊追打。</p></div>'+
    resolutionOrder.map(k=>'<div class="status-maker-guide-item"><b>'+esc(STATUS_RESOLUTION_LABELS[k])+'</b><p>'+esc(STATUS_RESOLUTION_DETAILS[k])+'</p></div>').join('')+
    '<div class="status-maker-guide-item status-maker-guide-wide"><b>增減益</b><p>'+Object.keys(STATUS_MODIFIER_LABELS).map(k=>(STATUS_MODIFIER_LABELS[k]||k)+'：'+(STATUS_MODIFIER_DETAILS[k]||'')).join('　').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')+'</p></div>'+
    '<div class="status-maker-guide-item status-maker-guide-wide"><b>控制</b><p>'+Object.keys(STATUS_CONTROL_LABELS).map(k=>(STATUS_CONTROL_LABELS[k]||k)+'：'+(STATUS_CONTROL_DETAILS[k]||'')).join('　').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')+'</p></div>'+
  '</div></details>';
}
function statusPreview(s){
  const bits=['持續 '+s.duration+' 回合'];
  if(s.modifiers.length)bits.push('增減益：'+s.modifiers.map(x=>(STATUS_MODIFIER_LABELS[x.kind]||x.kind)+' '+Number((x.value*100).toFixed(3))+'%').join(' + '));
  if(s.control)bits.push('控制：'+(STATUS_CONTROL_LABELS[s.control.kind]||s.control.kind));
  if(s.periodic.length)bits.push('持續效果：'+s.periodic.map(x=>{const basis=STATUS_BASIS_LABELS[x.basis]||x.basis,res=STATUS_RESOLUTION_LABELS[x.resolution]||x.resolution,el=x.resolution==='elemental'?'／'+(STATUS_ELEMENT_LABELS[x.element]||x.element):'';return (x.kind==='heal'?'恢復 ':'傷害 ')+basis+' × '+x.coefficient+' → '+res+el;}).join(' + '));
  if(s.tags.includes('instant'))bits.push('立即行動：套用瞬間額外結算 periodic 1 次（不消耗後續持續結算）');
  const allowed=statusAllowedTargetsForDefinition(s);bits.push(allowed.length?'可用目標：'+allowed.map(x=>STATUS_TARGET_LABELS[x]).join('／'):'可用目標：無（同一狀態混合了我方限定與敵方限定增減益，請拆成兩個狀態）');
  return bits.join('\n');
}
function controlFieldsHtml(s){const c=s.control;if(!c)return '';
  let extra='';
  if(['freeze','rage','tauntRage'].includes(c.kind))extra+='<label>BOSS 控制回合<input data-status-control-num="bossDuration" type="number" min="0" max="99" step="1" value="'+esc(c.bossDuration)+'"></label>';
  if(c.kind==='frost')extra+='<label>速度降低<input data-status-control-num="slowPct" type="number" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="'+esc(c.slowPct)+'"></label>';
  if(['rage','tauntRage'].includes(c.kind))extra+='<label>普通攻擊增傷<input data-status-control-num="basicA
---
  fixed:'固定數值：係數本身就是每次結算的原始點數。',
  casterAttack:'施法者攻擊力：我方施法者讀目前 battleStats.atk，因此會包含當下攻擊提升；再乘係數。',
  casterMaxHp:'施法者最大生命：讀施法者目前最大生命，再乘係數。',
  casterCurrentHp:'施法者當前生命：每次結算當下重新讀取，不鎖定施放瞬間數值。',
  casterMissingHp:'施法者已損生命：每次結算以「最大生命－當前生命」重新計算。',
  casterDefense:'施法者防禦：我方施法者讀目前 battleStats.def，再乘係數。',
  casterShield:'施法者護盾：讀普通 shield 欄位；變形護盾是獨立控制資料，不算在此係數。',
  casterLevel:'施法者等級：以目前等級直接乘係數。',
  targetAttack:'目標攻擊力：我方目標讀 battleStats.atk；敵方讀原始 atk，因此 weaken 不會降低此係數基準。',
  targetMaxHp:'目標最大生命：每次結算讀目前最大生命，再乘係數。',
  targetCurrentHp:'目標當前生命：每次結算當下重新讀取，會隨前一段傷害／恢復改變。',
  targetMissingHp:'目標已損生命：每次結算依當下缺血量重新計算。',
  targetDefense:'目標防禦：我方讀 battleStats.def；敵方讀原始 def（破甲／防無／防穿屬於後續傷害結算，不會先改寫此係數基準）。',

<script id="skill-induction-schema">
/* Shared induction contract; embedded verbatim in the standalone balance editor. */
(function(root){
  'use strict';
  const TAG='induce',EFFECT='induceSkill',MAX_TARGETS=2;
  const tagged=sk=>Array.isArray(sk?.tags)&&sk.tags.includes(TAG);
  const blocked=sk=>tagged(sk)||sk?.effect===EFFECT;
  const idFor=(sk,job,index)=>sk?.id||`job${job}-core${index}`;
  function validate(doc){
    const issues=[],pool=new Map();
    for(const [job,c] of (doc?.classes||[]).entries())for(const [index,sk] of (c.skills||[]).entries())pool.set(idFor(sk,job,index),{job,sk});
    for(const [job,c] of (doc?.classes||[]).entries())for(const [index,sk] of (c.skills||[]).entries()){
      const label=`技能 ${job}-${index}「${sk.name||''}」`;
      if(sk.tags!==undefined&&(!Array.isArray(sk.tags)||sk.tags.some(x=>typeof x!=='string')||new Set(sk.tags).size!==sk.tags.length))issues.push(label+'：tags 必須是不重複的文字陣列');
      if(sk.effect===EFFECT&&!tagged(sk))issues.push(label+'：誘發技能效果必須帶有誘發標籤');
      if(!tagged(sk)&&sk.induction===undefined)continue;
      if(!['active','proc'].includes(sk.activation))issues.push(label+'：誘發僅支援主動／觸發技能');
      const config=sk.induction,targets=config?.targets;
      if(!config||typeof config!=='object'||Array.isArray(config)||Object.keys(config).some(k=>k!=='targets'))issues.push(label+'：誘發設定只支援 targets，連鎖深度固定為一次');
      if(!Array.isArray(targets)||targets.length>MAX_TARGETS||tagged(sk)&&!targets?.length){issues.push(label+'：誘發需設定 1～2 個目標');continue;}
      const seen=new Set();
      for(const target of targets){
        if(!target||typeof target!=='object'||Array.isArray(target)){issues.push(label+'：誘發目標無效');continue;}
        if(typeof target.chance!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(target.chance)||target.chance<0||target.chance>1)issues.push(label+'：誘發機率必須介於 0～1');
        let key;
        if(target.kind==='activeSlot'||target.kind==='procSlot'){
          if(!Number.isInteger(target.slot)||target.s

    if(sk.effect==='revive')html+=number('復活生命比例','reviveHpRatio',value('reviveHpRatio'),.001,1,.001,'0.25＝恢復最大生命 25%；無陣亡目標時不施放。');
    if(amount){const defs=data.statusDefinitions||[],choices=['',...defs.map(d=>d.id)];if(sk.onHitStatusId&&!choices.includes(sk.onHitStatusId))choices.push(sk.onHitStatusId);html+=select('成功命中後附加狀態','onHitStatusId',value('onHitStatusId'),choices,Object.fromEntries([['','無'],...defs.map(d=>[d.id,d.name+' · '+d.id])]),'每次施放每目標最多判定一次；傷害閃避、死亡不附加。方向相容性由匯出檢查。')+number('附加狀態機率','onHitStatusChance',value('onHitStatusChance'),0,1,.001,'0＝不附加，1＝100%。');}

<script id="skill-induction-schema">
/* Shared induction contract; embedded verbatim in the standalone balance editor. */
(function(root){
  'use strict';
  const TAG='induce',EFFECT='induceSkill',MAX_TARGETS=2;
  const tagged=sk=>Array.isArray(sk?.tags)&&sk.tags.includes(TAG);
  const blocked=sk=>tagged(sk)||sk?.effect===EFFECT;
  const idFor=(sk,job,index)=>sk?.id||`job${job}-core${index}`;
  function validate(doc){
    const issues=[],pool=new Map();
    for(const [job,c] of (doc?.classes||[]).entries())for(const [index,sk] of (c.skills||[]).entries())pool.set(idFor(sk,job,index),{job,sk});
    for(const [job,c] of (doc?.classes||[]).entries())for(const [index,sk] of (c.skills||[]).entries()){
      const label=`技能 ${job}-${index}「${sk.name||''}」`;
      if(sk.tags!==undefined&&(!Array.isArray(sk.tags)||sk.tags.some(x=>typeof x!=='string')||new Set(sk.tags).size!==sk.tags.length))issues.push(label+'：tags 必須是不重複的文字陣列');
      if(sk.effect===EFFECT&&!tagged(sk))issues.push(label+'：誘發技能效果必須帶有誘發標籤');
      if(!tagged(sk)&&sk.induction===undefined)continue;
      if(!['active','proc'].includes(sk.activation))issues.push(label+'：誘發僅支援主動／觸發技能');
      const config=sk.induction,targets=config?.targets;
      if(!config||typeof config!=='object'||Array.isArray(config)||Object.keys(config).some(k=>k!=='targets'))issues.push(label+'：誘發設定只支援 targets，連鎖深度固定為一次');
      if(!Array.isArray(targets)||targets.length>MAX_TARGETS||tagged(sk)&&!targets?.length){issues.push(label+'：誘發需設定 1～2 個目標');continue;}
      const seen=new Set();
      for(const target of targets){
        if(!target||typeof target!=='object'||Array.isArray(target)){issues.push(label+'：誘發目標無效');continue;}
        if(typeof target.chance!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(target.chance)||target.chance<0||target.chance>1)issues.push(label+'：誘發機率必須介於 0～1');
        let key;
        if(target.kind==='activeSlot'||target.kind==='procSlot'){
          if(!Number.isInteger(target.slot)||target.slot<0||target.slot>1)issues.push(label+'：技能槽必須是 0 或 1');
          key=target.kind+':'+target.slot;
        }else if(target.kind==='skill'){
          const row=pool.get(target.skillId);key='skill:'+target.skillId;
          if(!row||row.job!==job)issues.push(label+'：指定誘發技能不存在或職業不符');
          else if(blocked(row.sk))issues.push(label+'：不可誘發帶有誘發標籤／誘發效果的技能');
        }else issues.push(label+'：誘發目標類型無效');
        if(seen.has(key))issues.push(label+'：誘發目標不可重複');seen.add(key);
      }
    }
    return issues;
  }
  const api={TAG,EFFECT,MAX_TARGETS,tagged,blocked,idFor,validate};
  root.EmberwildInduction=api;
  if(typeof module==='object'&&module.exports)module.exports=api;
})(globalThis);
</script>

validateData=function(){const issues=statusValidateDataBase(),defs=statusList(),ids=new Set();defs.forEach((s,i)=>{for(const x of validateStatusDefinition(s))issues.push('狀態 '+(i+1)+'：'+x);if(ids.has(s.id))issues.push('狀態 ID 重複：'+s.id);ids.add(s.id);});(data.classes||[]).forEach((c,job)=>(c.skills||[]).forEach((sk,i)=>{if(sk.effect!=='applyStatus')return;const def=defs.find(x=>x.id===String(sk.statusId||'')),target=sk.statusTarget||'enemy';if(!def)issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 引用不存在的狀態。');if(!STATUS_TARGETS.includes(target))issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 的狀態目標無效。');else if(def&&!statusAllowedTargetsForDefinition(def).includes(target))issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 的狀態效果與套用目標方向不相容。');}));return [...new Set(issues)];};

const statusRenderSkillsBase=renderSkills;
renderSkills=function(){statusRenderSkillsBase();if(selected.skillTab==='support')return;const sk=data.classes?.[selected.skillClass]?.skills?.[selected.skill];if(!sk||sk.effect!=='applyStatus')return;const defs=statusList(),selectedDef=defs.find(d=>d.id===sk.statusId)||null,allowedTargets=statusAllowedTargetsForDefinition(selectedDef),targetOptions=allowedTargets.length?labelOptions(allowedTargets,STATUS_TARGET_LABELS,allowedTargets.includes(sk.statusTarget)?sk.statusTarget:allowedTargets[0]):'<option value="">此狀態沒有相容的套用目標</option>',app=document.getElementById('app'),grid=app.querySelector('.grid2');if(!grid)return;const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='card';box.id='status-skill-link-card';box.innerHTML='<div class="card-h"><strong>自訂狀態套用</strong></div><div class="card-b"><div class="fields"><div class="field"><label>套用狀態</label><select id="skillStatusId"><option value="">請選擇</option>'+defs.map(d=>'<option value="'+esc(d.id)+'" '+(sk.statusId===d.id?'selected':'')+'>'+esc(d.name)+' · '+esc(d.id)+'</option>').join('')+'</select><div class="field-help">狀態本體只維護一份；技能以 statusId 引用。</div></div><div class="field"><label>套用目標</label><select id="skillStatusTarget">'+targetOptions+'</select><div class="field-help">敵方全體與我方全體會對目前全部存活單位各套用一份狀態。</div></div></div><div class="mini-note">此效果不使用上方「基礎效果倍率」作為狀態倍率；狀態內各係數直接由狀態製作器控制。技能冷卻、觸發率、前置條件、寶石與精通仍照原技能系統運作。</div></div>';grid.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',box);document.getElementById('skillStatusId').onchange=e=>{sk.statusId=e.target.value;const def=defs.find(d=>d.id===sk.statusId)||null,allowed=statusAllowedTargetsForDefinition(def);if(!allowed.includes(sk.statusTarget))sk.statusTarget=allowed[0]||'';markDirty();render();};document.getElementById('skillStatusTarget').onchange=e=>{sk.statusTarget=e.target.value;markDirty();};};

const statusRenderOverviewBase=renderOverview;
renderOverview=function(){statusRenderOverviewBase();const app=document.getElementById('app');if(!app)return;const stats=app.querySelector('.statgrid');if(stats)stats.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<div class="card stat"><div class="n">'+statusList().length+'</div><div class="l">自訂狀態</div></div>');const notice=[...app.querySelectorAll('.notice')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('真正會讀取')||x.textContent.includes('測試設定真正會讀取'));if(notice)notice.innerHTML='<b>重要：</b>這份 HTML 的測試設定會讀取 <span class="code">balanceSettings / balance / classes / supportSkills / equipmentForms / items / statusDefinitions</span>。自訂狀態可由套用狀態技能或共用技能效果的附加狀態引用。';};

globalThis.__EMBERWILD_STATUS_EDITOR_TEST_API={schema:STATUS_SCHEMA_VERSION,normalize:normalizeStatusDefinition,validate:validateStatusDefinition,selfTest:statusPureSelfTest,get definitions(){return deepCloneStatus(statusList());}};
requestEditorInitialRender();
})();
</script>

function normalizeEquipmentFormsSchema(){
  if(!Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms))data.equipmentForms=[];
  const classCount=data.classes.length;
  while(data.equipmentForms.length<classCount)data.equipmentForms.push([[],[],[],[]]);
  for(let ci=0;ci<classCount;ci++){
    let slots=Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms[ci])?data.equipmentForms[ci]:[];
    if(slots.length===3){
      const mixed=Array.isArray(slots[2])?slots[2]:[],offhand=mixed.length?[mixed[0]]:[],accessories=mixed.slice(1);
      if(!accessories.length&&mixed[0])accessories.push(structuredClone(mixed[0]));
      slots=[Array.isArray(slots[0])?slots[0]:[],Array.isArray(slots[1])?slots[1]:[],offhand,accessories];
    }
    while(slots.length<4)slots.push([]);
    data.equipmentForms[ci]=slots.slice(0,4);
  }
  let globalSlots=Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms[classCount])?data.equipmentForms[classCount]:[[],[],[],[]];
  if(globalSlots.length===3){
    const mixed=Array.isArray(globalSlots[2])?globalSlots[2]:[];
    globalSlots=[Array.isArray(globalSlots[0])?globalSlots[0]:[],Array.isArray(globalSlots[1])?globalSlots[1]:[],mixed.length?[mixed[0]]:[],mixed.slice(1)];
  }
  while(globalSlots.length<4)globalSlots.push([]);
  data.equipmentForms[classCount]=globalSlots.slice(0,4);
  data.equipmentForms.length=classCount+1;
}
function ensureArrays(){
  data.balanceSettings=deepFillDefaults(BALANCE_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS,data.balanceSettings);
  if(!Array.isArray(data.classes)) data.classes=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.supportSkills)) data.supportSkills=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms)) data.equipmentForms=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.items)) data.items=[];
  while(data.supportSkills.length < data.classes.length) data.supportSkills.push([]);
  normalizeEquipmentFormsSchema();
  const allWearableJobs=data.classes.map((_,i)=>i);
  data.equipmentForms.forEach((slots,ci)=>slots.forEach((forms,slot)=>{
    if(!Array.isArray(forms))return;
    for(const form of forms){
      if(!form||typeof form!=="object")continue;
      const fallback=ci>=data.classes.length||slot===1?[...allWearableJobs]:[ci];
      const raw=Array.isArray(form.wearableJobs)?form.wearableJobs:fallback;
      const jobs=[...new Set(raw.map(Number).filter(j=>Number.isInteger(j)&&j>=0&&j<data.classes.length))];
      form.wearableJobs=jobs.length?jobs:fallback;
      normalizeEquipmentFixedEffects(form);
    }
  }));
  for(let ci=0;ci<data.classes.length;ci++){
    const corePerLevelDefault=Number(data.balanceSettings?.skills?.core?.effectPerExtraLevel??.18);
    const supportPerLevelDefault=Number(data.balanceSettings?.skills?.support?.effectPerExtraLevel??.2);
    for(const sk of data.classes[ci]?.skills||[]){
      if(!Number.isFinite(sk.powerPerLevel))sk.powerPerLevel=Number.isFinite(corePerLevelDefault)?corePerLevelDefault:.18;
      normalizeSkillUsageScope(sk);
      ensureProcSkillFields(sk);
    }
    for(const sk of data.supportSkills[ci]||[]){
      if(!Number.isFinite(sk.effectPerLevel))sk.effectPerLevel=Number.isFinite(supportPerLevelDefault)?supportPerLevelDefault:.2;
    }
  }
}
if(!Array.isArray(data.notes))data.notes=[];

  'proc 技能使用 2 個普攻觸發槽；學會技能不等於自動啟用。',
  'procBaseChance 為 Lv1 基礎觸發率，procChancePerLevel 為每次升級增加率；舊 JSON 會依原全域公式換算。',
  '核心技能 powerPerLevel 與輔助技能 effectPerLevel 為每次升級直接加到基礎效果的倍率；基礎效果即 Lv1 數值，實際效果 = 基礎效果 + (技能等級 - 1) × 每級倍率。舊 JSON 缺少欄位時才沿用 balanceSettings 的全域預設。',
  'proc 專屬效果：nextActiveDamage=下次主動技能增傷；advanceNextRound=下回合行動提前 1 格；shieldLowest=最低生命比例隊友獲得攻擊力倍率護盾。'
])if(!data.notes.includes(note))data.notes.push(note);

function count(section,normalized=false){
  if(!normalized) ensureArrays();
  if(section==="classes") return data.classes.length;
  if(section==="skills") return data.classes.reduce((n,c)=>n+(Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills.length:0),0)+data.supportSkills.reduce((n,a)=>n+(Array.isArray(a)?a.length:0),0);
  if(section==="equipment") return data.equipmentForms.reduce((n,c)=>n+c.reduce((m,s)=>m+(Array.isArray(s)?s.length:0),0),0);
  if(section==="items") return data.items.length;
  if(section==="balanceSettings") return flattenSettingLeaves(data.balanceSettings).length;
  return "";
}
function renderNav(normalized=false){
  if(!normalized)ensureArrays();
  const nav=document.getElementById("nav");
  const scrollTop=nav.scrollTop;
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-nav-group]").forEach(group=>{
    if(group.open)expandedNavGroups.add(group.dataset.navGroup);
    else expandedNavGroups.delete(group.dataset.navGroup);
  });
  const pages=new Map(SECTION_META),assigned=new Set(["overview"]);
  const button=([id,label])=>{
    const n=count(id,true);
    return `
    <button type="button" class="navbtn ${currentSection===id?"active":""}" data-sec="${esc(id)}" ${currentSection===id?'aria-current="page"':""}>
      <span>${esc(label)}</span>${n!==""?`<span class="badge">${esc(n)}</span>`:""}
    </button>`;
  };
  const groups=NAV_GROUPS.map(([id,label,sections])=>({id,label,entries:sections.filter(sec=>pages.has(sec)).map(sec=>{assigned.add(sec);return [sec,pages.get(sec)];})}));

function normalizeEquipmentFormsSchema(){
  if(!Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms))data.equipmentForms=[];
  const classCount=data.classes.length;
  while(data.equipmentForms.length<classCount)data.equipmentForms.push([[],[],[],[]]);
  for(let ci=0;ci<classCount;ci++){
    let slots=Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms[ci])?data.equipmentForms[ci]:[];

      const mixed=Array.isArray(slots[2])?slots[2]:[],offhand=mixed.length?[mixed[0]]:[],accessories=mixed.slice(1);

      slots=[Array.isArray(slots[0])?slots[0]:[],Array.isArray(slots[1])?slots[1]:[],offhand,accessories];

    while(slots.length<4)slots.push([]);
    data.equipmentForms[ci]=slots.slice(0,4);
  }

  }
  while(globalSlots.length<4)globalSlots.push([]);

  data.equipmentForms.length=classCount+1;
}

  'proc 專屬效果：nextActiveDamage=下次主動技能增傷；advanceNextRound=下回合行動提前 1 格；shieldLowest=最低生命比例隊友獲得攻擊力倍率護盾。'
])if(!data.notes.includes(note))data.notes.push(note);

function count(section,normalized=false){
  if(!normalized) ensureArrays();
  if(section==="classes") return data.classes.length;
  if(section==="skills") return data.classes.reduce((n,c)=>n+(Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills.length:0),0)+data.supportSkills.reduce((n,a)=>n+(Array.isArray(a)?a.length:0),0);
  if(section==="equipment") return data.equipmentForms.reduce((n,c)=>n+c.reduce((m,s)=>m+(Array.isArray(s)?s.length:0),0),0);
  if(section==="items") return data.items.length;
  if(section==="balanceSettings") return flattenSettingLeaves(data.balanceSettings).length;
  return "";
}

      <span>${esc(label)}</span>${n!==""?`<span class="badge">${esc(n)}</span>`:""}
    </button>`;
  };
  const groups=NAV_GROUPS.map(([id,label,sections])=>({id,label,entries:sections.filter(sec=>pages.has(sec)).map(sec=>{assigned.add(sec);return [sec,pages.get(sec)];})}));
  // Keep future extension pages reachable even before they receive

}
function normalizeEquipmentFormsSchema(){
  if(!Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms))data.equipmentForms=[];
  const classCount=data.classes.length;
  while(data.equipmentForms.length<classCount)data.equipmentForms.push([[],[],[],[]]);
  for(let ci=0;ci<classCount;ci++){
    let slots=Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms[ci])?data.equipmentForms[ci]:[];
    if(slots.length===3){
      const mixed=Array.isArray(slots[2])?slots[2]:[],offhand=mixed.length?[mixed[0]]:[],accessories=mixed.slice(1);
      if(!accessories.length&&mixed[0])accessories.push(structuredClone(mixed[0]));
      slots=[Array.isArray(slots[0])?slots[0]:[],Array.isArray(slots[1])?slots[1]:[],offhand,accessories];
    }
    while(slots.length<4)slots.push([]);
    data.equipmentForms[ci]=slots.slice(0,4);
  }
  let globalSlots=Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms[classCount])?data.equipmentForms[classCount]:[[],[],[],[]];
  if(globalSlots.length===3){
    const mixed=Array.isArray(globalSlots[2])?globalSlots[2]:[];
    globalSlots=[Array.isArray(globalSlots[0])?globalSlots[0]:[],Array.isArray(globalSlots[1])?globalSlots[1]:[],mixed.length?[mixed[0]]:[],mixed.slice(1)];
  }
  while(globalSlots.length<4)globalSlots.push([]);
  data.equipmentForms[classCount]=globalSlots.slice(0,4);
  data.equipmentForms.length=classCount+1;
}
function ensureArrays(){
  data.balanceSettings=deepFillDefaults(BALANCE_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS,data.balanceSettings);
  if(!Array.isArray(data.classes)) data.classes=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.supportSkills)) data.supportSkills=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms)) data.equipmentForms=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.items)) data.items=[];
  while(data.supportSkills.length < data.classes.length) data.supportSkills.push([]);
  normalizeEquipmentFormsSchema();
  const allWearableJobs=data.classes.map((_,i)=>i);
  data.equipmentForms.forEach((slots,ci)=>slots.forEach((forms,slot)=>{
    if(!Array.isArray(forms))return;
    for(const form of forms){
      if(!form||typeof form!=="object")continue;
      const fallback=ci>=data.classes.length||slot===1?[...allWearableJobs]:[ci];
      const raw=Array.isArray(form.wearableJobs)?form.wearableJobs:fallback;
      const jobs=[...new Set(raw.map(Number).filter(j=>Number.isInteger(j)&&j>=0&&j<data.classes.length))];
      form.wearableJobs=jobs.length?jobs:fallback;
      normalizeEquipmentFixedEffects(form);
    }
  }));
  for(let ci=0;ci<data.classes.length;ci++){
    const corePerLevelDefault=Number(data.balanceSettings?.skills?.core?.effectPerExtraLevel??.18);
    const supportPerLevelDefault=Number(data.balanceSettings?.skills?.support?.effectPerExtraLevel??.2);
    for(const sk of data.classes[ci]?.skills||[]){
      if(!Number.isFinite(sk.powerPerLevel))sk.powerPerLevel=Number.isFinite(corePerLevelDefault)?corePerLevelDefault:.18;
      normalizeSkillUsageScope(sk);
      ensureProcSkillFields(sk);
    }
    for(const sk of data.supportSkills[ci]||[]){
      if(!Number.isFinite(sk.effectPerLevel))sk.effectPerLevel=Number.isFinite(supportPerLevelDefault)?supportPerLevelDefault:.2;
    }
  }
}
if(!Array.isArray(data.notes))data.notes=[];
for(const note of [
  'proc 技能使用 2 個普攻觸發槽；學會技能不等於自動啟用。',
  'procBaseChance 為 Lv1 基礎觸發率，procChancePerLevel 為每次升級增加率；舊 JSON 會依原全域公式換算。',
  '核心技能 powerPerLevel 與輔助技能 effectPerLevel 為每次升級直接加到基礎效果的倍率；基礎效果即 Lv1 數值，實際效果 = 基礎效果 + (技能等級 - 1) × 每級倍率。舊 JSON 缺少欄位時才沿用 balanceSettings 的全域預設。',
  'proc 專屬效果：nextActiveDamage=下次主動技能增傷；advanceNextRound=下回合行動提前 1 格；shieldLowest=最低生命比例隊友獲得攻擊力倍率護盾。'
])if(!data.notes.includes(note))data.notes.push(note);

  if(section==="skills") return data.classes.reduce((n,c)=>n+(Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills.length:0),0)+data.supportSkills.reduce((n,a)=>n+(Array.isArray(a)?a.length:0),0);
  if(section==="equipment") return data.equipmentForms.reduce((n,c)=>n+c.reduce((m,s)=>m+(Array.isArray(s)?s.length:0),0),0);

  // Keep future extension pages reachable even before they receive a category.

function count(section,normalized=false){

  if(section==="classes") return data.classes.length;
  if(section==="skills") return data.classes.reduce((n,c)=>n+(Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills.length:0),0)+data.supportSkills.reduce((n,a)=>n+(Array.isArray(a)?a.length:0),0);

function renderNav(normalized=false){
  if(!normalized)ensureArrays();
  const nav=document.getElementById("nav");
  const scrollTop=nav.scrollTop;
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-nav-group]").forEach(group=>{
    if(group.open)expandedNavGroups.add(group.dataset.navGroup);
    else expandedNavGroups.delete(group.dataset.navGroup);
  });
  const pages=new Map(SECTION_META),assigned=new Set(["overview"]);
  const button=([id,label])=>{
    const n=count(id,true);
    return `
    <button type="button" class="navbtn ${currentSection===id?"active":""}" data-sec="${esc(id)}" ${currentSection===id?'aria-current="page"':""}>
      <span>${esc(label)}</span>${n!==""?`<span class="badge">${esc(n)}</span>`:""}
    </button>`;
  };
  const groups=NAV_GROUPS.map(([id,label,sections])=>({id,label,entries:sections.filter(sec=>pages.has(sec)).map(sec=>{assigned.add(sec);return [sec,pages.get(sec)];})}));
  // Keep future extension pages reachable even before they receive a category.
  groups.find(group=>group.id==="tools").entries.push(...SECTION_META.filter(([id])=>!assigned.has(id)));
  nav.innerHTML=(pages.has("overview")?button(["overview",pages.get("overview")]):"")+groups.map(group=>{
    if(!group.entries.length)return "";
    const active=group.entries.some(([id])=>id===currentSection);
    if(active)expandedNavGroups.add(group.id);
    return `<details class="nav-group ${active?"has-active":""}" data-nav-group="${group.id}" ${expandedNavGroups.has(group.id)?"open":""}>
      <summary><span>${esc(group.label)}</span><span class="nav-group-count">${group.entries.length} 項</span></summary>
      <div class="nav-group-items">${group.entries.map(button).join("")}</div>
    </details>`;
  }).join("");
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-sec]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{currentSection=b.dataset.sec; render();});
  nav.scrollTop=scrollTop;
}
function render(){
  ensureArrays();
  renderNav(true);
  const app=document.getElementById("app");
  const renderers={
    overview:renderOverview,classes:renderClasses,skills:renderSkills,
    equipment:renderEquipment,items:renderItems,balanceSettings:renderBalanceSettings,
    balance:renderBalance,raw:renderRaw
  };
  app.innerHTML="";
  renderers[currentSection]();
}

function count(section,normalized=false){
  if(!normalized) ensureArrays();
  if(section==="classes") return data.classes.length;
  if(section==="skills") return data.classes.reduce((n,c)=>n+(Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills.length:0),0)+data.supportSkills.reduce((n,a)=>n+(Array.isArray(a)?a.length:0),0);
  if(section==="equipment") return data.equipmentForms.reduce((n,c)=>n+c.reduce((m,s)=>m+(Array.isArray(s)?s.length:0),0),0);
  if(section==="items") return data.items.length;
  if(section==="balanceSettings") return flattenSettingLeaves(data.balanceSettings).length;
  return "";
}
function renderNav(normalized=false){
  if(!normalized)ensureArrays();
  const nav=document.getElementById("nav");
  const scrollTop=nav.scrollTop;
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-nav-group]").forEach(group=>{
    if(group.open)expandedNavGroups.add(group.dataset.navGroup);
    else expandedNavGroups.delete(group.dataset.navGroup);
  });
  const pages=new Map(SECTION_META),assigned=new Set(["overview"]);
  const button=([id,label])=>{
    const n=count(id,true);
    return `
    <button type="button" class="navbtn ${currentSection===id?"active":""}" data-sec="${esc(id)}" ${currentSection===id?'aria-current="page"':""}>
      <span>${esc(label)}</span>${n!==""?`<span class="badge">${esc(n)}</span>`:""}
    </button>`;
  };
  const groups=NAV_GROUPS.map(([id,label,sections])=>({id,label,entries:sections.filter(sec=>pages.has(sec)).map(sec=>{assigned.add(sec);return [sec,pages.get(sec)];})}));
  // Keep future extension pages reachable even before they receive a category.
  groups.find(group=>group.id==="tools").entries.push(...SECTION_META.filter(([id])=>!assigned.has(id)));
  nav.innerHTML=(pages.has("overview")?button(["overview",pages.get("overview")]):"")+groups.map(group=>{
    if(!group.entries.length)return "";
    const active=group.entries.some(([id])=>id===currentSection);
    if(active)expandedNavGroups.add(group.id);
    return `<details class="nav-group ${active?"has-active":""}" data-nav-group="${group.id}" ${expandedNavGroups.has(group.id)?"open":""}>
      <summary><span>${esc(group.label)}</span><span class="nav-group-count">${group.entries.length} 項</span></summary>
      <div class="nav-group-items">${group.entries.map(button).join("")}</div>
    </details>`;
  }).join("");
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-sec]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{currentSection=b.dataset.sec; render();});
  nav.scrollTop=scrollTop;
}
function render(){
  ensureArrays();
  renderNav(true);
  const app=document.getElementById("app");
  const renderers={
    overview:renderOverview,classes:renderClasses,skills:renderSkills,
    equipment:renderEquipment,items:renderItems,balanceSettings:renderBalanceSettings,
    balance:renderBalance,raw:renderRaw
  };
  app.innerHTML="";
  renderers[currentSection]();
}
function sectionHead(title,desc,actions=""){
  return `<div class="section-head"><div><h1>${title}</h1><p>${desc}</p></div><div class="section-actions">${actions}</div></div>`;
}
function card(title,body,extra=""){
  return `<div class="card"><div class="card-h"><strong>${title}</strong>${extra}</div><div class="card-b">${body}</div></div>`;
}
function inputField(label,key,value,type="text",extra="",full=false,help="",readonly=false){
  const id="f_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  return `<div class="field ${full?"full":""}"><label for="${id}">${fieldTitle(label,key,readonly)}</label><input id="${id}" data-key="${esc(key)}" type="${type}" value="${esc(value)}" ${extra} ${readonly?"readonly":""}>${helpText(help)}</div>`;
}
function selectField(label,key,value,opts,full=false,help="",labels=null,disabled=false){
  const id="f_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  const pairs=opts.map(x=>typeof x==="object"?x:{value:x,label:labels?.[x]||x});
  return `<div class="field ${full?"full":""}"><label for="$
---
ea id="${id}" data-key="${esc(key)}">${esc(value)}</textarea>${helpText(help)}</div>`;
}
function bindObjectFields(container,obj){
  container.querySelectorAll("[data-key]").forEach(el=>{
    el.onchange=()=>{
      const k=el.dataset.key;
      if(el.dataset.json==="1"){
        try{obj[k]=JSON.parse(el.value); el.style.borderColor=""; markDirty();}catch{el.style.borderColor="var(--danger)";}
        return;
      }
      if(el.type==="number") obj[k]=el.value===""?0:Number(el.value);
      else if(el.dataset.bool==="1" || (el.tagName==="SELECT" && (el.value==="true"||el.value==="false"))) obj[k]=el.value==="true";
      else obj[k]=el.value;
      markDirty();
    };
  });
}
function confirmDelete(msg){ return window.confirm(msg); }

function renderOverview(){
  const issues=validateData();
  const stats=[
    ["角色",count("classes")],["核心技能",count("skills")],["輔助技能",count("support")],["裝備變體",count("equipment")],
    ["商店道具",count("items")],["平衡設定",count("balanceSettings")],["詞條設定",flattenSettingLeaves(data.balance||{}).length],["地圖門檻",data.balanceSettings?.maps?.levelRanges?.length||0]
  ];
  document.getElementById("app").innerHTML =
    sectionHead("總覽","遊戲中可安全資料化的平衡數值已集中到 balanceSettings；本頁以中文名稱編輯，匯出仍保留遊戲需要的 JSON key。",
      `<button id="validateBtn">檢查相容性</button><button id="resetBtn" class="danger">還原最初資料</button>`) +
    `<div class="statgrid">${stats.map(([l,n])=>`<div class="card stat"><div class="n">${n}</div><div class="l">${l}</div></div>`).join("")}</div>` +
    (issues.length?`<div class="errornotice"><b>與目前 HTML 的匯入規則相比，發現 ${issues.length} 個提醒：</b><br>${issues.map(x=>"• "+esc(x)).join("<br>")}</div>`:`<div class="oknotice">目前結構符合這份 HTML 的主要測試設定匯入規則。</div>`) +
    `<div class="notice"><b>重要：</b>這份 HTML 的測試設定真正會讀取的是 <span class="code">balance / classes / supportSkills / equipmentForms / items</span>。怪物、掉落、強化仍寫死在 HTML 程式中，額外建立同名 JSON 區塊不會改變遊戲。</div>`+
    card("目前檔案",`<div class="fields">
      ${inputField("設定格式版本","schema",data.schema||"","text","",false,"遊戲匯入固定要求 emberwild-balance-v1；修改會直接匯入失敗。",true)}
      <div class="field"><label>頂層區塊</label><input value="${esc(Object.keys(data).join(", "))}" readonly><div class="field-help">只有遊戲程式實際讀取的區塊會產生效果。</div></div>
      <div class="field full"><label>相容性摘要</label><div class="mini-note">角色數固定為 4；每職業輔助技能實際系統固定 3 個；商店元素道具固定 15 筆且 id／type／element 不可改。核心技能與裝備變體可增減，但刪除或改變順序可能使既有存檔的索引對應改變。</div></div>
    </div>`);
  document.getElementById("validateBtn").onclick=()=>render();
  document.getElementById("resetBtn").onclick=()=>{
    if(confirmDelete("確定要放棄目前所有修改，還原成開啟編輯器時的原始 JSON？")){
      data=structuredClone(ORIGINAL_DATA); selected={class:0,skillClass:0,skill:0,supportClass:0,support:0,equipClass:0,equipSlot:0,equip:0,item:0,generic:{monsters:0,drops:0,enhancement:0}};
      markDirty("已還原原始資料，尚未匯出"); render();
    }
  };
}

function classList(active){
  return `<div class="list">${data.classes.map((c,i)=>`
    <div class="listitem ${i===active?"active":""}" data-index="${i}">
      <div class="title">${esc(c.name||"(未命名角色)")}</div>
      <div class="sub">角色索引 ${i} · ${esc(c.advanced||"")}</div>
    </div>`).join("") || `<div class="empty">目前沒有角色</div>`}</div>`;
}
function renderClasses(){
  selected.class=Math.min(selected.class,Math.max(0,data.classes.length-1));
  const c=data.classes[selected.class];
  document.getElementById("app").innerHTML =
    sectionHead("角色","HTML 以 classes 陣列索引 0~3 對應四職業；目前版本不能新增或刪除職業，否則匯入會被拒絕。") +
    `<div class="notice">角色 <span class="code">id</span> 不參與套用，真正對應依陣列順序。二轉條件、二轉加成與能力點效果仍寫死在 HTML，不由這份 JSON 控制。</div>`+
    `<div class="grid2">
      <div class="card">${classList(selected.class)}</div>
      ${c?card("角色資料",`<div class="fields">
        ${inputField("角色 ID（識別用）","id",c.id,"number","step=1",false,"遊戲套用角色時依陣列索引，不使用此 id；建議保持原值。",true)}
        ${inputField("職業名稱","name",c.name||"","text","",false,"角色名稱、裝備職業標示等顯示用。")}
        ${inputField("二轉名稱","advanced",c.advanced||"","text","",false,"只改二轉顯示名稱；LV15、生命+18%、攻擊+22%、防禦+15%及二轉成本仍由 HTML 固定。")}
        ${inputField("主要屬性名稱","main",c.main||"","text","",false,"只改能力點頁面的屬性名稱；第一欄能力點仍固定每點攻擊力 +2。")}
        ${inputField("角色基礎生命","hp",c.hp??0,"number","min=0.0001 step=1",false,"角色 1 級未計裝備與能力點時的基礎生命；必須大於 0。")}
        ${inputField("角色基礎攻擊","atk",c.atk??0,"number","min=0.0001 step=1",false,"角色 1 級未計裝備與能力點時的基礎攻擊；必須大於 0。")}
        ${inputField("角色基礎防禦","def",c.def??0,"number","min=0 step=1",false,"角色 1 級未計裝備與能力點時的基礎防禦；可為 0。")}
        <div class="field"><label>核心技能數</label><input value="${Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills.length:0}" readonly><div class="field-help">技能可增減，但既有存檔以技能索引保存等級與寶石；改順序或刪除會改變對應。</div></div>
      </div>`):card("角色資料",`<div class="empty">JSON 結構異常：沒有角色資料</div>`)}
    </div>`;
  const app=document.getElementById("app");
  app.querySelectorAll(".listitem[data-index]").forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{selected.class=Number(x.dataset.index);render();});
  if(c) bindObjectFields(app,c);
}


const SKILL_USAGE_SCOPES=["character","monster","elite","boss","shared"];
const SKILL_USAGE_SCOPE_LABELS={character:"人物",monster:"怪物",elite:"菁英",boss:"BOSS",shared:"共用"};
function normalizeSkillUsageScope(sk){
  if(!sk||typeof sk!=="object")return "character";
  sk.usageScope=SKILL_USAGE_SCOPES.includes(sk.usageScope)?sk.usageScope:"character";
  return sk.usageScope;
}

      ${selectField("技能屬性標示","element",sk.element||"physical",ELEMENTS,false,"目前輔助技能的 element 主要用於介面標示，實際 buff/debuff 強度不做元素剋制計算。",ELEMENT_LABELS)}

  if(sk){bindObjectFields(app,sk);}
}

<script id="status-maker-editor-v1">
(()=>{
/* STATUS_PURE_START */
const STATUS_SCHEMA_VERSION=1;
const STATUS_TAGS=['periodic','control','modifier','instant'];
const STATUS_MODIFIER_KINDS=['attack','critical','guard','fracture','power','weaken','vulnerable','damageAmp','regen','followup'];
const STATUS_CONTROL_KINDS=['polymorph','freeze','frost','rage','fear','tauntRage'];
const STATUS_PERIODIC_KINDS=['damage','heal'];
const STATUS_BASIS=['fixed','casterAttack','casterMaxHp','casterCurrentHp','casterMissingHp','casterDefense','casterShield','casterLevel','targetAttack','targetMaxHp','targetCurrentHp','targetMissingHp','targetDefense','targetShield','targetLevel'];
const STATUS_DAMAGE_RESOLUTIONS=['fixed','defended','elemental','true'];
const STATUS_HEAL_RESOLUTIONS=['heal','overflowShield'];
const STATUS_ELEMENTS=['physical','fire','ice','wind','light','shadow'];
function statusNum(v,fallback=0){v=Number(v);return Number.isFinite(v)?v:fallback;}
function statusInt(v,fallback=0,min=0,max=99){return Math.max(min,Math.min(max,Math.round(statusNum(v,fallback))));}
function statusClamp01(v,fallback=0){return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,statusNum(v,fallback)));}
function statusPolarity(def){
  if(['buff','debuff','neutral'].includes(def?.polarity))return def.polarity;
  let good=false,bad=!!def?.control;
  for(const m of def?.modifiers||[]){if(!m.value)continue;const negative=['fracture','weaken','vulnerable','damageAmp','followup'].includes(m.kind);if(negative===(m.value>0))bad=true;else good=true;}
  for(const fx of def?.periodic||[]){if(!(fx.coefficient>0))continue;if(fx.kind==='heal')good=true;else bad=true;}
  return good===bad?'neutral':good?'buff':'debuff';
}
function normalizeStatusDefinition(raw,index=0){
  raw=raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};
  const tags=[...new Set((Array.isArray(raw.tags)?raw.tags:[]).filter(x=>STATUS_TAGS.includes(x)))];
  const modifiers=tags.includes('modifier')?(Array.isArray(raw.modifiers)?raw.modifiers:[]).slice(0,3).map(x=>({kind:STATUS_MODIFIER_KINDS.includes(x?.kind)?x.kind:'attack',value:statusNum(x?.value,0),element:STATUS_ELEMENTS.includes(x?.element)?x.element:'physical'})):[];
  let control=null;
  if(tags.includes('control')&&raw.control&&STATUS_CONTROL_KINDS.includes(raw.control.kind)){
    control={
      kind:raw.control.kind,
      bossDuration:statusInt(raw.control.bossDuration,Math.min(statusInt(raw.duration,1,1,99),1),0,99),
      slowPct:statusClamp01(raw.control.slowPct,.30),
      basicAttackBonus:statusClamp01(raw.control.basicAttackBonus,.20),
      damageReduction:statusClamp01(raw.control.damageReduction,.20),
      skipChance:statusClamp01(raw.control.skipChance,.30),
      bossSkipChance:statusClamp01(raw.control.bossSkipChance,.15)
    };
  }
  const periodic=tags.includes('periodic')?(Array.isArray(raw.periodic)?raw.periodic:[]).slice(0,3).map(x=>{
    const kind=STATUS_PERIODIC_KINDS.includes(x?.kind)?x.kind:'damage';
    const allowed=kind==='heal'?STATUS_HEAL_RESOLUTIONS:STATUS_DAMAGE_RESOLUTIONS;
    return {kind,basis:STATUS_BASIS.includes(x?.basis)?x.basis:'casterAttack',coefficient:Math.max(0,statusNum(x?.coefficient,0)),resolution:allowed.includes(x?.resolution)?x.resolution:allowed[0],element:STATUS_ELEMENTS.includes(x?.element)?x.element:'physical'};
  }):[];
  return {polarity:['auto','buff','debuff','neutral'].includes(raw.polarity)?raw.polarity:'auto',dispellable:raw.dispellable!==false,id:String(raw.id||('status-'+(index+1))).trim()||('status-'+(index+1)),name:String(raw.name||'未命名狀態').trim()||'未命名狀態',tags,duration:statusInt(raw.duration,1,1,99),modifiers,control,periodic};
}
function validateStatusDefinition(raw){
  c
---
rim()||'未命名狀態',tags,duration:statusInt(raw.duration,1,1,99),modifiers,control,periodic};
}
function validateStatusDefinition(raw){
  const s=normalizeStatusDefinition(raw),issues=[];
  if(!s.id)issues.push('缺少狀態 ID');
  if(!s.name)issues.push('缺少狀態名稱');
  if(!Number.isInteger(s.duration)||s.duration<1||s.duration>99)issues.push('持續回合必須介於 1～99');
  if(s.modifiers.length>3)issues.push('增減益最多三種');
  if(s.periodic.length>3)issues.push('持續傷害／恢復最多三種');
  if(s.control&&!STATUS_CONTROL_KINDS.includes(s.control.kind))issues.push('控制類型無效');
  for(const fx of s.periodic){if(!STATUS_BASIS.includes(fx.basis)||fx.coefficient<0)issues.push('持續效果係數設定無效');}
  return issues;
}
function statusPureSelfTest(){
  const samples=[
    {id:'cap-test',name:'上限測試',tags:['modifier','control','periodic','instant'],duration:150,modifiers:[{kind:'attack',value:.1},{kind:'guard',value:.2},{kind:'critical',value:.3},{kind:'power',value:.4}],control:{kind:'freeze',bossDuration:2},periodic:[{kind:'damage',basis:'casterAttack',coefficient:.2,resolution:'fixed'},{kind:'damage',basis:'targetMaxHp',coefficient:.05,resolution:'elemental',element:'fire'},{kind:'heal',basis:'targetMissingHp',coefficient:.3,resolution:'overflowShield'},{kind:'heal',basis:'fixed',coefficient:5,resolution:'heal'}]},
    {id:'dot',name:'灼燒',tags:['periodic'],duration:3,periodic:[{kind:'damage',basis:'casterAttack',coefficient:.25,resolution:'defended',element:'fire'}]},
    {id:'hot',name:'再生',tags:['periodic','instant'],duration:4,periodic:[{kind:'heal',basis:'targetMaxHp',coefficient:.05,resolution:'heal'}]},
    {id:'cc',name:'冰封',tags:['control'],duration:2,control:{kind:'freeze',bossDuration:1}}
  ];
  const normalized=samples.map(normalizeStatusDefinition),issues=normalized.flatMap(validateStatusDefinition);
  return {schema:STATUS_SCHEMA_VERSION,ok:issues.length===0&&normalized[0].duration===99&&normalized[0].modifiers.length===3&&normalized[0].periodic.length===3,issues,summary:normalized.map(s=>({id:s.id,duration:s.duration,tags:s.tags,modifiers:s.modifiers.length,control:s.control?.kind||null,periodic:s.periodic.length}))};
}

<script id="status-maker-editor-v1">
(()=>{
/* STATUS_PURE_START */
const STATUS_SCHEMA_VERSION=1;
const STATUS_TAGS=['periodic','control','modifier','instant'];
const STATUS_MODIFIER_KINDS=['attack','critical','guard','fracture','power','weaken','vulnerable','damageAmp','regen','followup'];
const STATUS_CONTROL_KINDS=['polymorph','freeze','frost','rage','fear','tauntRage'];
const STATUS_PERIODIC_KINDS=['damage','heal'];
const STATUS_BASIS=['fixed','casterAttack','casterMaxHp','casterCurrentHp','casterMissingHp','casterDefense','casterShield','casterLevel','targetAttack','targetMaxHp','targetCurrentHp','targetMissingHp','targetDefense','targetShield','targetLevel'];
const STATUS_DAMAGE_RESOLUTIONS=['fixed','defended','elemental','true'];
const STATUS_HEAL_RESOLUTIONS=['heal','overflowShield'];
const STATUS_ELEMENTS=['physical','fire','ice','wind','light','shadow'];
function statusNum(v,fallback=0){v=Number(v);return Number.isFinite(v)?v:fallback;}
function statusInt(v,fallback=0,min=0,max=99){return Math.max(min,Math.min(max,Math.round(statusNum(v,fallback))));}
function statusClamp01(v,fallback=0){return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,statusNum(v,fallback)));}
function statusPolarity(def){
  if(['buff','debuff','neutral'].includes(def?.polarity))return def.polarity;
  let good=false,bad=!!def?.control;
  for(const m of def?.modifiers||[]){if(!m.value)continue;const negative=['fracture','weaken','vulnerable','damageAmp','followup'].includes(m.kind);if(negative===(m.value>0))bad=true;else good=true;}
  for(const fx of def?.periodic||[]){if(!(fx.coefficient>0))continue;if(fx.kind==='heal')good=true;else bad=true;}
  return good===bad?'neutral':good?'buff':'debuff';
}
function normalizeStatusDefinition(raw,index=0){
  raw=raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};
  const tags=[...new Set((Array.isArray(raw.tags)?raw.tags:[]).filter(x=>STATUS_TAGS.includes(x)))];
  const modifiers=tags.includes('modifier')?(Array.isArray(raw.modifiers)?raw.modifiers:[]).slice(0,3).map(x=>({kind:STATUS_MODIFIER_KINDS.includes(x?.kind)?x.kind:'attack',value:statusNum(x?.value,0),element:STATUS_ELEMENTS.includes(x?.element)?x.element:'physical'})):[];
  let control=null;
  if(tags.includes('control')&&raw.control&&STATUS_CONTROL_KINDS.includes(raw.control.kind)){
    control={
      kind:raw.control.kind,
      bossDuration:statusInt(raw.control.bossDuration,Math.min(statusInt(raw.duration,1,1,99),1),0,99),
      slowPct:statusClamp01(raw.control.slowPct,.30),
      basicAttackBonus:statusClamp01(raw.control.basicAttackBonus,.20),
      damageReduction:statusClamp01(raw.control.damageReduction,.20),
      skipChance:statusClamp01(raw.control.skipChance,.30),
      bossSkipChance:statusClamp01(raw.control.bossSkipChance,.15)
    };
  }
  const periodic=tags.includes('periodic')?(Array.isArray(raw.periodic)?raw.periodic:[]).slice(0,3).map(x=>{
    const kind=STATUS_PERIODIC_KINDS.includes(x?.kind)?x.kind:'damage';
    const allowed=kind==='heal'?STATUS_HEAL_RESOLUTIONS:STATUS_DAMAGE_RESOLUTIONS;
    return {kind,basis:STATUS_BASIS.includes(x?.basis)?x.basis:'casterAttack',coefficient:Math.max(0,statusNum(x?.coefficient,0)),resolution:allowed.includes(x?.resolution)?x.resolution:allowed[0],element:STATUS_ELEMENTS.includes(x?.element)?x.element:'physical'};
  }):[];
  return {polarity:['auto','buff','debuff','neutral'].includes(raw.polarity)?raw.polarity:'auto',dispellable:raw.dispellable!==false,id:String(raw.id||('status-'+(index+1))).trim()||('status-'+(index+1)),name:String(raw.name||'未命名狀態').trim()||'未命名狀態',tags,duration:statusInt(raw.duration,1,1,99),modifiers,control,periodic};
}

  const s=normalizeStatusDefinitio

function normalizeStatusDefinition(raw,index=0){
  raw=raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};
  const tags=[...new Set((Array.isArray(raw.tags)?raw.tags:[]).filter(x=>STATUS_TAGS.includes(x)))];
  const modifiers=tags.includes('modifier')?(Array.isArray(raw.modifiers)?raw.modifiers:[]).slice(0,3).map(x=>({kind:STATUS_MODIFIER_KINDS.includes(x?.kind)?x.kind:'attack',value:statusNum(x?.value,0),element:STATUS_ELEMENTS.includes(x?.element)?x.element:'physical'})):[];
  let control=null;
  if(tags.includes('control')&&raw.control&&STATUS_CONTROL_KINDS.includes(raw.control.kind)){
    control={
      kind:raw.control.kind,
      bossDuration:statusInt(raw.control.bossDuration,Math.min(statusInt(raw.duration,1,1,99),1),0,99),
      slowPct:statusClamp01(raw.control.slowPct,.30),
      basicAttackBonus:statusClamp01(raw.control.basicAttackBonus,.20),
      damageReduction:statusClamp01(raw.control.damageReduction,.20),
      skipChance:statusClamp01(raw.control.skipChance,.30),
      bossSkipChance:statusClamp01(raw.control.bossSkipChance,.15)
    };
  }
  const periodic=tags.includes('periodic')?(Array.isArray(raw.periodic)?raw.periodic:[]).slice(0,3).map(x=>{
    const kind=STATUS_PERIODIC_KINDS.includes(x?.kind)?x.kind:'damage';
    const allowed=kind==='heal'?STATUS_HEAL_RESOLUTIONS:STATUS_DAMAGE_RESOLUTIONS;
    return {kind,basis:STATUS_BASIS.includes(x?.basis)?x.basis:'casterAttack',coefficient:Math.max(0,statusNum(x?.coefficient,0)),resolution:allowed.includes(x?.resolution)?x.resolution:allowed[0],element:STATUS_ELEMENTS.includes(x?.element)?x.element:'physical'};
  }):[];
  return {polarity:['auto','buff','debuff','neutral'].includes(raw.polarity)?raw.polarity:'auto',dispellable:raw.dispellable!==false,id:String(raw.id||('status-'+(index+1))).trim()||('status-'+(index+1)),name:String(raw.name||'未命名狀態').trim()||'未命名狀態',tags,duration:statusInt(raw.duration,1,1,99),modifiers,control,periodic};
}
function validateStatusDefinition(raw){
  const s=normalizeStatusDefinition(raw),issues=[];
  if(!s.id)issues.push('缺少狀態 ID');
  if(!s.name)issues.push('缺少狀態名稱');
  if(!Number.isInteger(s.duration)||s.duration<1||s.duration>99)issues.push('持續回合必須介於 1～99');
  if(s.modifiers.length>3)issues.push('增減益最多三種');
  if(s.periodic.length>3)issues.push('持續傷害／恢復最多三種');
  if(s.control&&!STATUS_CONTROL_KINDS.includes(s.control.kind))issues.push('控制類型無效');
  for(const fx of s.periodic){if(!STATUS_BASIS.includes(fx.basis)||fx.coefficient<0)issues.push('持續效果係數設定無效');}
  return issues;
}

function periodicRowsHtml(s){return s.periodic.map((fx,i)=>{const resolutions=fx.kind==='heal'?STATUS_HEAL_RESOLUTIONS:STATUS_DAMAGE_RESOLUTIONS;return '<div class="status-maker-row" data-status-periodic-row="'+i+'"><label>類型<select data-status-periodic-kind>'+labelOptions(STATUS_PERIODIC_KINDS,{damage:'持續傷害',heal:'持續恢復'},fx.kind)+'</select></label><label>係數基準<select data-status-periodic-basis>'+labelOptions(STATUS_BASIS,STATUS_BASIS_LABELS,fx.basis)+'</select></label><label>係數<input data-status-periodic-coefficient type="number" min="0" step="0.001" value="'+esc(fx.coefficient)+'"></label><label>結算方式<select data-status-periodic-resolution>'+labelOptions(resolutions,STATUS_RESOLUTION_LABELS,fx.resolution)+'</select></label><label>元素<select data-status-periodic-element '+(fx.resolution==='elemental'?'':'disabled')+'>'+labelOptions(STATUS_ELEMENTS,STATUS_ELEMENT_LABELS,fx.element)+'</select></label><button type="button" class="danger" data-status-periodic-del="'+i+'">刪除</button><div class="mini-note status-maker-row-help">'+esc(statusPeriodicRuleText(fx))+'</div></div>';}).join('');}
function renderStatuses(){
  const list=statusList();selectedStatusIndex=Math.max(0,Math.min(selectedStatusIndex,list.length-1));const s=list[selectedStatusIndex]||null,app=document.getElementById('app');
  app.innerHTML=sectionHead('狀態製作器','建立可重用的狀態，再到「技能」把主要效果設為「套用自訂狀態」。','<button id="addStatus">新增狀態</button>'+(s?'<button id="dupStatus">複製</button><button id="delStatus" class="danger">刪除</button>':''))+
    '<div class="notice"><b>結構：</b>每個狀態最多 3 個增減益、1 個控制、3 個持續傷害／恢復；持續 1～99 回合。係數可以直接使用固定值、施法者／目標的攻擊、最大／當前／已損生命、防禦、護盾或等級。固定值時「係數」本身就是數值。</div>'+
    statusRuleGuideHtml()+
    '<div class="status-maker-layout"><div class="card status-maker-list"><div class="list">'+(list.map((x,i)=>'<div class="listitem '+(i===selectedStatusIndex?'active':'')+'" data-status-index="'+i+'"><div class="title">'+esc(x.name)+'</div><div class="sub">'+esc(x.id)+' · '+x.duration+' 回合 · '+x.tags.map(t=>STATUS_TAG_LABELS[t]).join('／')+'</div></div>').join('')||'<div class="empty">尚未建立狀態。</div>')+'</div></div>'+
    (s?'<div><div class="card"><div class="card-h"><strong>狀態本體</strong><span class="pill">'+esc(s.id)+'</span></div><div class="card-b"><div class="fields">'+
      '<div class="field full"><label>狀態名稱</label><input id="statusName" value="'+esc(s.name)+'"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="fields"><div class="field"><label>解除分類</label><select id="statusPolarity">'+labelOptions(['auto','buff','debuff','neutral'],{auto:'自動判定',buff:'增益（可驅散）',debuff:'減益（可淨化）',neutral:'中性（不由淨化／驅散解除）'},s.polarity)+'</select><div class="field-help">自動判定依效果正負分類；混合正負為中性。</div></div><div class="field"><label>允許解除</label><input id="statusDispellable" type="checkbox" '+(s.dispellable?'checked':'')+'><div class="field-help">關閉後不能由淨化／驅散解除，仍正常到期。</div></div></div>'+
      '<div class="field full"><label>狀態標籤（可複選）</label><div class="status-maker-tags">'+STATUS_TAGS.map(t=>'<label><input type="checkbox" data-status-tag="'+t+'" '+(s.tags.includes(t)?'checked':'')+'>'+STATUS_TAG_LABELS[t]+'</label>').join('')+'</div></div>'+
      '<div class="fields"><div class="field"><label>持續回合</label><input id="statusDuration" type="number" min="1" max="99" step="1" value="'+s.duration+'"><div class="field-help">最高 99。增減益依戰鬥回合存在；嵌入既有控制時仍沿用該控制本身的 BOSS／目標行動規則。</div></div></div>'+
      (s.tags.includes('modifier')?'<div class="status-maker-block"><div class="row"><b>增減益效果</b><span class="status-maker-limit">'+s.modifiers.length+' / 3</span><button id="addStatusModifier" '+(s.modifiers.length>=3?'disabled':'')+'>新增效果</button></div>'+modifierRowsHtml(s)+'</div>':'')+
      (s.tags.includes('control')?'<div class="status-maker-block"><b>控制（最多一種）</b>'+controlFieldsHtml(s)+'</div>':'')+
      (s.tags.includes('periodic')?'<div class="status-maker-block"><div class="row"><b>持續傷害／恢復</b><span class="status-maker-limit">'+s.periodic.length+' / 3</span><button id="addStatusPeriodic" '+(s.periodic.length>=3?'disabled':'')+'>新增持續效果</button></div><div class="mini-note">傷害可選固定、防禦影響、完整元素或真實傷害；恢復可選一般恢復或溢出轉護盾。元素欄只有「完整元素傷害」會生效。</div>'+periodicRowsHtml(s)+'</div>':'')+
      '<div class="status-maker-preview"><b>效果預覽</b>\n'+esc(statusPreview(s))+'</div></div></div>':'<div class="card"><div class="empty">按「新增狀態」開始建立。</div></div>')+'</div>';
  app.querySelectorAll('[data-status-index]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>{selectedStatusIndex=Number(el.dataset.statusIndex);render();});
  document.getElementById('addStatus').onclick=()=>{const id=nextStatusId();list.push(normalizeStatusDefinition({id,name:'新狀態',tags:[],duration:3},list.length));selectedStatusIndex=list.length-1;markDirty('已新增狀態');render();};
  if(!s)return;

  app.querySelectorAll('[data-status-periodic-row]').forEach(row=>{const i=Number(row.dataset.statusPeriodicRow),fx=s.periodic[i];row.querySelector('[data-status-periodic-kind]').onchange=e=>{fx.kind=e.target.value;fx.resolution=fx.kind==='heal'?'heal':'fixed';markDirty();render();};row.querySelector('[data-status-periodic-basis]').onchange=e=>{fx.basis=e.target.value;markDirty();render();};row.querySelector('[data-status-periodic-coefficient]').onchange=e=>{fx.coefficient=Math.max(0,statusNum(e.target.value,0));markDirty();render();};row.querySelector('[data-status-periodic-resolution]').onchange=e=>{fx.resolution=e.target.value;markDirty();render();};row.querySelector('[data-status-periodic-element]').onchange=e=>{fx.element=e.target.value;markDirty();render();};});
  app.querySelectorAll('[data-status-periodic-del]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{s.periodic.splice(Number(b.dataset.statusPeriodicDel),1);markDirty();render();});
}

if(!EFFECTS.includes('applyStatus'))EFFECTS.push('applyStatus');

const statusValidateDataBase=validateData;
validateData=function(){const issues=statusValidateDataBase(),defs=statusList(),ids=new Set();defs.forEach((s,i)=>{for(const x of validateStatusDefinition(s))issues.push('狀態 '+(i+1)+'：'+x);if(ids.has(s.id))issues.push('狀態 ID 重複：'+s.id);ids.add(s.id);});(data.classes||[]).forEach((c,job)=>(c.skills||[]).forEach((sk,i)=>{if(sk.effect!=='applyStatus')return;const def=defs.find(x=>x.id===String(sk.statusId||'')),target=sk.statusTarget||'enemy';if(!def)issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 引用不存在的狀態。');if(!STATUS_TARGETS.includes(target))issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 的狀態目標無效。');else if(def&&!statusAllowedTargetsForDefinition(def).includes(target))issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 的狀態效果與套用目標方向不相容。');}));return [...new Set(issues)];};

const statusRenderSkillsBase=renderSkills;
renderSkills=function(){statusRenderSkillsBase();if(selected.skillTab==='support')return;const sk=data.classes?.[selected.skillClass]?.skills?.[selected.skill];if(!sk||sk.effect!=='applyStatus')return;const defs=statusList(),selectedDef=defs.find(d=>d.id===sk.statusId)||null,allowedTargets=statusAllowedTargetsForDefinition(selectedDef),targetOptions=allowedTargets.length?labelOptions(allowedTargets,STATUS_TARGET_LABELS,allowedTargets.includes(sk.statusTarget)?sk.statusTarget:allowedTargets[0]):'<option value="">此狀態沒有相容的套用目標</option>',app=document.getElementById('app'),grid=app.querySelector('.grid2');if(!grid)return;const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='card';box.id='status-skill-link-card';box.innerHTML='<div class="card-h"><strong>自訂狀態套用</strong></div><div class="card-b"><div class="fields"><div class="field"><label>套用狀態</label><select id="skillStatusId"><option value="">請選擇</option>'+defs.map(d=>'<option value="'+esc(d.id)+'" '+(sk.statusId===d.id?'selected':'')+'>'+esc(d.name)+' · '+esc(d.id)+'</option>').join('')+'</select><div class="field-help">狀態本體只維護一份；技能以 statusId 引用。</div></div><div class="field"><label>套用目標</label><select id="skillStatusTarget">'+targetOptions+'</select><div class="field-help">敵方全體與我方全體會對目前全部存活單位各套用一份狀態。</div></div></div><div class="mini-note">此效果不使用上方「基礎效果倍率」作為狀態倍率；狀態內各係數直接由狀態製作器控制。技能冷卻、觸發率、前置條件、寶石與精通仍照原技能系統運作。</div></div>';grid.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',box);document.getElementById('skillStatusId').onchange=e=>{sk.statusId=e.target.value;const def=defs.find(d=>d.id===sk.statusId)||null,allowed=statusAllowedTargetsForDefinition(def);if(!allowed.includes(sk.statusTarget))sk.statusTarget=allowed[0]||'';markDirty();render();};document.getElementById('skillStatusTarget').onchange=e=>{sk.statusTarget=e.target.value;markDirty();};};

const EQUIPMENT_FIXED_EFFECT_KEYS=EQUIPMENT_FIXED_EFFECT_DEFS.map(x=>x.key);
const EQUIPMENT_FIXED_EFFECT_BY_KEY=Object.fromEntries(EQUIPMENT_FIXED_EFFECT_DEFS.map(x=>[x.key,x]));
const EQUIPMENT_FIXED_RACES={beast:"野獸",plant:"植物",undead:"不死",construct:"構裝",demon:"惡魔",spirit:"精靈"};
function fixedEffectDefault(key){
  if(key==="basicElement")return "physical";
  if(["basicAdvanceNextRound","allCooldownReduction","skillCooldownReduction"].includes(key))return 1;
  return 0;
}
function equipmentFixedSkillJobs(form){
  const jobs=Array.isArray(form?.wearableJobs)?[...new Set(form.wearableJobs.map(Number).filter(j=>Number.isInteger(j)&&j>=0&&j<data.classes.length))]:[];
  return jobs.length?jobs:data.classes.map((_,i)=>i);
}
function equipmentFixedSkillCount(form){
  return equipmentFixedSkillJobs(form).reduce((max,job)=>Math.max(max,(data.classes[job]?.skills||[]).length),0);
}
function equipmentFixedSkillLabel(form,index){
  const names=[...new Set(equipmentFixedSkillJobs(form).map(job=>data.classes[job]?.skills?.[index]?.name).filter(Boolean))];
  return `核心技能 ${index+1}${names.length?" · "+names.join("／"):""}`;
}
function normalizeEquipmentFixedEffects(form){
  if(!form||typeof form!=="object")return;
  let rows=Array.isArray(form.fixedEffects)?form.fixedEffects.map(x=>x&&typeof x==="object"?{...x}:null).filter(Boolean):[];
  if(!rows.length){
    const legacy=[];
    const ex=form.exclusive&&typeof form.exclusive==="object"&&!Array.isArray(form.exclusive)?{...form.exclusive}:{};
    const pct=value=>Number(((Number(value)-1)*100).toFixed(2));
    if(Number.isFinite(form.atk)&&form.atk!==1)ex.gearAtkPct=(ex.gearAtkPct||0)+pct(form.atk);
    if(Number.isFinite(form.hp)&&form.hp!==1)ex.gearHpPct=(ex.gearHpPct||0)+pct(form.hp);
    if(Number.isFinite(form.def)&&form.def!==1)ex.gearDefPct=(ex.gearDefPct||0)+pct(form.def);
    for(const key of ["crit","critDamage","pierce","lifesteal","evasion","elementBonus","defenseIgnore"])if(Number.isFinite(form[key])&&form[key]!==0)ex[key]=(ex[key]||0)+form[key];
    let manaAttack=0;
    if(Number.isFinite(form.mp)&&form.mp>0)manaAttack+=Math.max(1,Math.round(form.mp/15));
    if(Number.isFinite(form.mpRegen)&&form.mpRegen>0)manaAttack+=Math.max(1,Math.round(form.mpRegen));
    if(manaAttack)ex.attackPct=(ex.attackPct||0)+manaAttack;
    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(ex))legacy.push({key,value});
    if(ELEMENTS.includes(form.element)&&form.element!=="physical")legacy.push({key:"basicElement",value:form.element});
    rows=legacy;
  }
  rows=rows.filter(x=>EQUIPMENT_FIXED_EFFECT_KEYS.includes(x.key)).slice(0,5).map(x=>{
    const out={key:x.key,value:x.key==="basicElement"?(ELEMENTS.includes(x.value)?x.value:"physical"):Number.isFinite(Number(x.value))?Number(x.value):fixedEffectDefault(x.key)};
    const def=EQUIPMENT_FIXED_EFFECT_BY_KEY[x.key];
    if(def?.target==="element")out.element=ELEMENTS.includes(x.element)&&x.element!=="physical"?x.element:"fire";
    if(def?.target==="race")out.race=Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(EQUIPMENT_FIXED_RACES,x.race)?x.race:"beast";
    if(def?.target==="skill")out.skill=Math.max(0,Number.isInteger(Number(x.skill))?Number(x.skill):0);
    return out;
  });
  if(ELEMENTS.includes(form.element)&&form.element!=="physical"&&!rows.some(x=>x.key==="basicElement"))rows.unshift({key:"basicElement",value:form.element});
  if(rows.length>5)rows=rows.slice(0,5);
  if(!rows.length)rows=[{

  crit:"直接增加最終暴擊率，最後受 balance.combat.statCaps.crit 上限限制。",
  critDamage:"加在基礎 150% 暴擊傷害上，目前沒有獨立上限。",
  pierce:"最後直接扣除敵人的固定防禦值；百分比防禦無視會先計算。",
  defenseIgnore:"按百分比降低敵人剩餘防禦；先於固定防禦穿透計算。",
  lifesteal:"依實際造成傷害回復本人生命，最後受吸血上限限制。",
  evasion:"敵方普攻命中前判定閃避，最後受閃避上限限制。",
  elementBonus:"增加火／冰／風／光／暗傷害；無屬性 physical 不吃此加成。"
};

function deepFillDefaults(def,src){
  if(Array.isArray(def))return def.map((v,i)=>deepFillDefaults(v,Array.isArray(src)?src[i]:undefined));
  if(def&&typeof def==="object"){const out=src&&typeof src==="object"&&!Array.isArray(src)?structuredClone(src):{};for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(def))out[k]=deepFillDefaults(v,src&&typeof src==="object"?src[k]:undefined);return out;}
  return src===undefined?def:src;
}
function flattenSettingLeaves(v,path="",out=[]){
  if(Array.isArray(v)){v.forEach((x,i)=>flattenSettingLeaves(x,path?path+"."+i:String(i),out));return out;}
  if(v&&typeof v==="object"){for(const [k,x] of Object.entries(v))flattenSettingLeaves(x,path?path+"."+k:k,out);return out;}
  out.push([path,v]);return out;
}

  if(exact[p])return {label:exact[p][0],help:exact[p][1]};
  let m=p.match(/^equipment\.boss\.(powerByDifficulty|skillEffectByDifficulty|affixRankByDifficulty)\.(\d+)$/);
  if(m){const mode=MODE_NAMES[+m[2]]||`難度 ${m[2]}`,n={powerByDifficulty:"BOSS 裝基礎能力倍率",skillEffectByDifficulty:"BOSS 裝固定技能效果 %",affixRankByDifficulty:"BOSS 裝固定詞條品質階級"}[m[1]];return {label:`${mode}－${n}`,help:m[1]==="affixRankByDifficulty"?"0=普通、1=精良、2=稀有、3=傳說。":"依目前製作／掉落難度套用。"};}
  m=p.match(/^difficulty\.modes\.(\d+)\.(hp|attack|defense|reward|bossGearChance|ore|legendaryGearChance)$/);
  if(m){const mode=MODE_NAMES[+m[1]]||`難度 ${m[1]}`,n={hp:"怪物生命倍率",attack:"怪物攻擊倍率",defense:"怪物防禦倍率",reward:"金幣／經驗倍率",bossGearChance:"BOSS 專屬裝掉率",ore:"鍛鐵倍率",legendaryGearChance:"額外傳說裝掉率"}[m[2]];return {label:`${mode}－${n}`,help:["bossGearChance","legendaryGearChance"].includes(m[2])?"使用 0~1 小數機率。":"該難度套用的倍率。"};}
  m=p.match(/^difficulty\.modes\.(\d+)\.(equipmentChance|gemChance)\.(\d+)$/);
  if(m){const mode=MODE_NAMES[+m[1]],kind=ENEMY_KIND_NAMES[+m[3]],what=m[2]==="equipmentChance"?"裝備掉率":"技能寶石掉率";return {label:`${mode}－${kind}${what}`,help:"0~1 小數；敵人種類索引依普通／菁英／BOSS。"};}
  m=p.match(/^difficulty\.materialChance\.(\d+)$/);if(m)return {label:`${MODE_NAMES[+m[1]]}－專屬素材掉率`,help:"普通怪使用此機率；菁英／BOSS 目前仍保證掉落素材。"};
  m=p.match(/^combat\.speed\.heroBase\.(\d+)$/);if(m)return {label:`${CLASS_NAMES[+m[1]]||m[1]}基礎速度`,help:"角色速度公式的職業固定值。"};
  m=p.match(/^combat\.speed\.race\.(.+)$/);if(m){const n={beast:"野獸",plant:"植物",undead:"不死",construct:"構裝",demon:"惡魔",spirit:"精靈"}[m[1]]||m[1];return {label:`${n}速度修正`,help:"敵人種族對速度的固定加減值，可為負數。"};}
  m=p.match(/^combat\.speed\.kind\.(.+)$/);if(m){const n={normal:"普通怪",elite:"菁英",boss:"BOSS",final:"終局 BOSS"}[m[1]]||m[1];return {label:`${n}速度修正`,help:"敵人種類對速度的固定加成。"};}
  m=p.match(/^combat\.pacing\.rates\.(\d+)$/);if(m)return {label:`倍速按鈕第 ${+m[1]+1} 段`,help:"點擊倍速按鈕時循環使用的倍率。"};
  m=p.match(/^quests\.tutorial\.(killRequirement|skillLevelRequirement|rewardGold|rewardOre|armorTier|armorSlot|armorQuality)$/);
  if(m){const n={killRequirement:"教學：擊殺數需求",skillLevelRequirement:"教學：技能等級需求",rewardGold:"教學：每階段金幣獎勵",rewardOre:"教學：每階段鍛鐵獎勵",armorTier:"教學護甲階級",armorSlot:"教學裝備部位",armorQuality:"教學裝備品質標記"}[m[1]];return {label:n,help:m[1]==="armorSlot"?"0=武器、1=護甲、2=副手。":m[1]==="armorQuality"?"舊 rar 標記；目前裝備品質主要由詞條決定。":"新手三步教學使用。"};}
  m=p.match(/^quests\.side\.(\d+)\.(required|gold|ore|gem)$/);if(m){const titles=["縫補獵人的披肩","淨化沼澤","鍛造師的最後一課"],n={required:"素材需求",gold:"金幣獎勵",ore:"鍛鐵獎勵",gem:"隨機寶石數"}[m[2]];return {label:`${titles[+m[1]]||'支線 '+(+m[1]+1)}－${n}`,help:"一次性支線任務。"};}
  m=p.match(/^maps\.levelRanges\.(\d+)\.(min|max)$/);if(m){const name=MAP_NAMES[+m[1]]||`地圖 ${+m[1]+1}`;return {label:`${name}－${m[2]==="min"?"最低等級":"最高等級"}`,help:"控制地圖顯示範圍、怪物等級與進入門檻；最低值不得高於最高值。"};}
  return {label:p.split(".").at(-1),help:"此數值已由遊戲 HTML 改為從 balanceSettings 讀取。"};
}

function esc(v){
  return String(v ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g,s=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;","\"":"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[s]));

function markDirty(msg="尚未匯出"){
  dirty=true;
  const el=document.getElementById("status");
  el.className="status unsaved"; el.textContent=msg;
}
function markSaved(msg="已匯出"){
  dirty=false;
  const el=document.getElementById("status");
  el.className="status saved"; el.textContent=msg;
}
const PROC_ONLY_EFFECTS=new Set(["nextActiveDamage","advanceNextRound","shieldLowest"]);
function legacyProcSkillRates(){
  const p=data.balanceSettings?.skills?.proc||{},per=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number.isFinite(Number(p.perSkillLevel))?Number(p.perSkillLevel):.025)),pre=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number.isFinite(Number(p.baseChance))?Number(p.baseChance):.22));
  return {base:Math.min(1,pre+per),per};
}
function ensureProcSkillFields(sk){
  if(!sk||sk.activation!=="proc")return;
  const d=legacyProcSkillRates();
  if(!Number.isFinite(sk.procBaseChance))sk.procBaseChance=d.base;
  if(!Number.isFinite(sk.procChancePerLevel))sk.procChancePerLevel=d.per;
  sk.procBaseChance=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(sk.procBaseChance)));
  sk.procChancePerLevel=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(sk.procChancePerLevel)));
}

const PROC_ONLY_EFFECTS=new Set(["nextActiveDamage","advanceNextRound","shieldLowest"]);
function legacyProcSkillRates(){
  const p=data.balanceSettings?.skills?.proc||{},per=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number.isFinite(Number(p.perSkillLevel))?Number(p.perSkillLevel):.025)),pre=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number.isFinite(Number(p.baseChance))?Number(p.baseChance):.22));
  return {base:Math.min(1,pre+per),per};
}
function ensureProcSkillFields(sk){
  if(!sk||sk.activation!=="proc")return;
  const d=legacyProcSkillRates();
  if(!Number.isFinite(sk.procBaseChance))sk.procBaseChance=d.base;
  if(!Number.isFinite(sk.procChancePerLevel))sk.procChancePerLevel=d.per;
  sk.procBaseChance=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(sk.procBaseChance)));
  sk.procChancePerLevel=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(sk.procChancePerLevel)));
}

  if(!Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms))data.equipmentForms=[];
  const classCount=data.classes.length;

function ensureArrays(){
  data.balanceSettings=deepFillDefaults(BALANCE_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS,data.balanceSettings);
  if(!Array.isArray(data.classes)) data.classes=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.supportSkills)) data.supportSkills=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms)) data.equipmentForms=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.items)) data.items=[];
  while(data.supportSkills.length < data.classes.length) data.supportSkills.push([]);
  normalizeEquipmentFormsSchema();
  const allWearableJobs=data.classes.map((_,i)=>i);
  data.equipmentForms.forEach((slots,ci)=>slots.forEach((forms,slot)=>{
    if(!Array.isArray(forms))return;
    for(const form of forms){
      if(!form||typeof form!=="object")continue;
      const fallback=ci>=data.classes.length||slot===1?[...allWearableJobs]:[ci];
      const raw=Array.isArray(form.wearableJobs)?form.wearableJobs:fallback;
      const jobs=[...new Set(raw.map(Number).filter(j=>Number.isInteger(j)&&j>=0&&j<data.classes.length))];
      form.wearableJobs=jobs.length?jobs:fallback;
      normalizeEquipmentFixedEffects(form);
    }
  }));
  for(let ci=0;ci<data.classes.length;ci++){
    const corePerLevelDefault=Number(data.balanceSettings?.skills?.core?.effectPerExtraLevel??.18);
    const supportPerLevelDefault=Number(data.balanceSettings?.skills?.support?.effectPerExtraLevel??.2);
    for(const sk of data.classes[ci]?.skills||[]){
      if(!Number.isFinite(sk.powerPerLevel))sk.powerPerLevel=Number.isFinite(corePerLevelDefault)?corePerLevelDefault:.18;
      normalizeSkillUsageScope(sk);
      ensureProcSkillFields(sk);
    }
    for(const sk of data.supportSkills[ci]||[]){
      if(!Number.isFinite(sk.effectPerLevel))sk.effectPerLevel=Number.isFinite(supportPerLevelDefault)?supportPerLevelDefault:.2;
    }
  }
}
if(!Array.isArray(data.notes))data.notes=[];
for(const note of [
  'proc 技能使用 2 個普攻觸發槽；學會技能不等於自動啟用。',
  'procBaseChance 為 Lv1 基礎觸發率，procChancePerLevel 為每次升級增加率；舊 JSON 會依原全域公式換算。',
  '核心技能 powerPerLevel 與輔助技能 effectPerLevel 為每次升級直接加到基礎效果的倍率；基礎效果即 Lv1 數值，實際效果 = 基礎效果 + (技能等級 - 1) × 每級倍率。舊 JSON 缺少欄位時才沿用 balanceSettings 的全域預設。',
  'proc 專屬效果：nextActiveDamage=下次主動技能增傷；advanceNextRound=下回合行動提前 1 格；shieldLowest=最低生命比例隊友獲得攻擊力倍率護盾。'
])if(!data.notes.includes(note))data.notes.push(note);

function count(section,normalized=false){
  if(!normalized) ensureArrays();
  if(section==="classes") return data.classes.length;
  if(section==="skills") return data.classes.reduce((n,c)=>n+(Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills.length:0),0)+data.supportSkills.reduce((n,a)=>n+(Array.isArray(a)?a.length:0),0);
  if(section==="equipment") return data.equipmentForms.reduce((n,c)=>n+c.reduce((m,s)=>m+(Array.isArray(s)?s.length:0),0),0);
  if(section==="items") return data.items.length;
  if(section==="balanceSettings") return flattenSettingLeaves(data.balanceSettings).length;
  return "";
}
function renderNav(normalized=false){
  if(!normalized)ensureArrays();
  const nav=document.getElementById("nav");
  const scrollTop=nav.scrollTop;
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-nav-group]").forEach(group=>{
    if(group.open)expandedNavGroups.add(group.dataset.navGroup);
    else expandedNavGroups.delete(group.dataset.navGroup);
  });
  const pages=new Map(SECTION_META),assigned=new Set(["overview"]);
  const button=([id,label])=>{
    const n=count(id,true);
    return `
    <button type="button" class="navbtn ${currentSection===id?"active":""}" data-sec="${esc(id)}" ${currentSection===id?'aria-current="page"':""}>
      <span>${esc(label)}</span>${n!==""?`<span class="badge">${esc(n)}</span>`:""}
    </button>`;
  };
  const groups=NAV_GROUPS.map(([id,label,sections])=>({id,label,entries:sections.filter(sec=>pages.has(sec)).map(sec=>{assigned.add(sec);return [sec,pages.get(sec)];})}));
  // Keep future extension pages reachable even before they receive a category.
  groups.find(group=>group.id==="tools").entries.push(...SECTION_META.filter(([id])=>!assigned.has(id)));
  nav.innerHTML=(pages.has("overview")?button(["overview",pages.get("overview")]):"")+groups.map(group=>{
    if(!group.entries.length)return "";
    const active=group.entries.some(([id])=>id===currentSection);
    if(active)expandedNavGroups.add(group.id);
    return `<details class="nav-group ${active?"has-active":""}" data-nav-group="${group.id}" ${expandedNavGroups.has(group.id)?"open":""}>
      <summary><span>${esc(group.label)}</span><span class="nav-group-count">${group.entries.length} 項</span></summary>
      <div class="nav-group-items">${group.entries.map(button).join("")}</div>
    </details>`;
  }).join("");
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-sec]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{currentSection=b.dataset.sec; render();});
  nav.scrollTop=scrollTop;
}
function render(){
  ensureArrays();
  renderNav(true);
  const app=document.getElementById("app");
  const renderers={
    overview:renderOverview,classes:renderClasses,skills:renderSkills,
    equipment:renderEquipment,items:renderItems,balanceSettings:renderBalanceSettings,
    balance:renderBalance,raw:renderRaw
  };
  app.innerHTML="";
  renderers[currentSection]();
}
function sectionHead(title,desc,actions=""){
  return `<div class="section-head"><div><h1>${title}</h1><p>${desc}</p></div><div class="section-actions">${actions}</div></div>`;
}

  if(!Array.isArray(data.classes)) data.classes=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.supportSkills)) data.supportSkills=[];

  }
}

    </button>`;
  };
  const groups=NAV_GROUPS.map(([id,label,sections])=>({id,label,entries:sections.filter(sec=>pages.has(sec)).map(sec=>{assigned.add(sec);return [sec,pages.get(sec)];})}));
  // Keep future extension pages reachable even before they receive a category.
  groups.find(group=>group.id==="tools").entries.push(...SECTION_META.filter(([id])=>!assigned.has(id)));
  nav.innerHTML=(pages.has("overview")?button(["overview",pages.get("overview")]):"")+groups.map(group=>{
    if(!group.entries.length)return "";
    const active=group.entries.some(([id])=>id===currentSection);
    if(active)expandedNavGroups.add(group.id);
    return `<details class="nav-group ${active?"has-active":""}" data-nav-group="${group.id}" ${expandedNavGroups.has(group.id)?"open":""}>
      <summary><span>${esc(group.label)}</span><span class="nav-group-count">${group.entries.length} 項</span></summary>
      <div class="nav-group-items">${group.entries.map(button).join("")}</div>
    </details>`;
  }).join("");
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-sec]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{currentSection=b.dataset.sec; render();});
  nav.scrollTop=scrollTop;
}
function render(){
  ensureArrays();
  renderNav(true);
  const app=document.getElementById("app");
  const renderers={
    overview:renderOverview,classes:renderClasses,skills:renderSkills,
    equipment:renderEquipment,items:renderItems,balanceSettings:renderBalanceSettings,
    balance:renderBalance,raw:renderRaw
  };
  app.innerHTML="";
  renderers[currentSection]();
}

function card(title,body,

  if(!Array.isArray(data.equipmentForms)) data.equipmentForms=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(data.items)) data.items=[];
  while(data.supportSkills.length < data.classes.length) data.supportSkills.push([]);
  normalizeEquipmentFormsSchema();
  const allWearableJobs=data.classes.map((_,i)=>i);

    if(!Array.isArray(forms))return;
    for(const form of forms){
      if(!form||typeof form!=="object")continue;
      const fallback=ci>=data.classes.length||slot===1?[...allWearableJobs]:[ci];
      const raw=Array.isArray(form.wearableJobs)?form.wearableJobs:fallback;
      const jobs=[...new Set(raw.map(Number).filter(j=>Number.isInteger(j)&&j>=0&&j<data.classes.length))];
      form.wearableJobs=jobs.length?jobs:fallback;
      normalizeEquipmentFixedEffects(form);

    for(const sk of data.classes[ci]?.skills||[]){

    for(const sk of data.supportSkills[ci]||[]){

  'proc 專屬效果：nextActiveDamage=下次主動技能增傷；advanceNextRound=下回合行動提前 1 格；shieldLowest=最低生命比例隊友獲得攻擊力倍率護盾。'

function count(section,normalized=false){
  if(!normalized) ensureArrays();
  if(section==="classes") return data.classes.length;
  if(section==="skills") return data.classes.reduce((n,c)=>n+(Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills.length:0),0)+data.supportSkills.reduce((n,a)=>n+(Array.isArray(a)?a.length:0),0);
  if(section==="equipment") return data.equipmentForms.reduce((n,c)=>n+c.reduce((m,s)=>m+(Array.isArray(s)?s.length:0),0),0);
  if(section==="items") return data.items.length;
  if(section==="balanceSettings") return flattenSettingLeaves(data.balanceSettings).length;
  return "";
}
function renderNav(normalized=false){
  if(!normalized)ensureArrays();
  const nav=document.getElementById("nav");
  const scrollTop=nav.scrollTop;
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-nav-group]").forEach(group=>{
    if(group.open)expandedNavGroups.add(group.dataset.navGroup);
    else expandedNavGroups.delete(group.dataset.navGroup);
  });
  const pages=new Map(SECTION_META),assigned=new Set(["overview"]);
  const button=([id,label])=>{
    const n=count(id,true);
    return `
    <button type="button" class="navbtn ${currentSection===id?"active":""}" data-sec="${esc(id)}" ${currentSection===id?'aria-current="page"':""}>
      <span>${esc(label)}</span>${n!==""?`<span class="badge">${esc(n)}</span>`:""}
    </button>`;
  };
  const groups=NAV_GROUPS.map(([id,label,sections])=>({id,label,entries:sections.filter(sec=>pages.has(sec)).map(sec=>{assigned.add(sec);return [sec,pages.get(sec)];})}));
  // Keep future extension pages reachable even before they receive a category.
  groups.find(group=>group.id==="tools").entries.push(...SECTION_META.filter(([id])=>!assigned.has(id)));
  nav.innerHTML=(pages.has("overview")?button(["overview",pages.get("overview")]):"")+groups.map(group=>{
    if(!group.entries.length)return "";
    const active=group.entries.some(([id])=>id===currentSection);
    if(active)expandedNavGroups.add(group.id);
    return `<details class="nav-group ${active?"has-active":""}" data-nav-group="${group.id}" ${expandedNavGroups.has(group.id)?"open":""}>
      <summary><span>${esc(group.label)}</span><span class="nav-group-count">${group.entries.length} 項</span></summary>
      <div class="nav-group-items">${group.entries.map(button).join("")}</div>
    </details>`;
  }).join("");
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-sec]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{currentSection=b.dataset.sec; render();});
  nav.scrollTop=scrollTop;
}
function render(){
  ensureArrays();
  renderNav(true);
  const app=document.getElementById("app");
  const renderers={
    overview:renderOverview,classes:renderClasses,skills:renderSkills,
    equipment:renderEquipment,items:renderItems,balanceSettings:renderBalanceSettings,
    balance:renderBalance,raw:renderRaw
  };
  app.innerHTML="";
  renderers[currentSection]();
}

}

  function normalizeSupportMechanic(sk){
    if(!sk||typeof sk!=='object')return sk;
    if(sk.kind==='vulnerable')sk.kind=sk.name==='元素灼印'?'followup':'damageAmp';

  function valueHelp(sk){
    if(sk.kind==='followup')return `0~1 小數。追打基礎傷害＝施放者攻擊力 × 此比例；之後依序套用目標防禦、element 屬性克制與目標減傷。追打不暴擊，也不再次吃 damageAmp / vulnerable。`;
    if(sk.kind==='dotAttack')return `0~1 小數。目標每次自身行動前，直接受到「施放者攻擊力 × 此比例」固定傷害；不吃防禦、抗性、增傷、減傷、暴擊或屬性克制。`;
    if(sk.kind==='dotMaxHp')return `0~1 小數。目標每次自身行動前，直接受到「目標最大生命 × 此比例」固定傷害；不吃防禦、抗性、增傷、減傷、暴擊或屬性克制。`;
    if(sk.kind==='damageAmp')return `0~1 小數。目標受到攻擊時，只把該次攻擊傷害提高此比例；例如 0.20 = 該次傷害 +20%。`;
    return `使用 0~1 小數，例如 0.18 = 18%。目前值約 ${percentPreview(sk.value)}；技能升級幅度由本技能的 effectPerLevel 決定。`;
  }
  function elementHelp(sk){
    if(sk.kind==='followup')return '追打的實際傷害屬性，可設定無／火／冰／風／光／暗。會依屬性克制計算，並同時受到目標防禦與減傷影響。';

      const issues=debuffValidateBase();ensureArrays();
      for(const [ci,list] of (data.supportSkills||[]).entries())for(const [si,sk] of (list||[]).entries()){
        normalizeSupportMechanic(sk);
        if(!SUPPORT_KINDS.includes(sk.kind))issues.push(`角色 ${ci} 輔助技能 ${si} 的效果類型無效。`);
        if(!ELEMENTS.includes(sk.element))issues.push(`角色 ${ci} 輔助技能 ${si} 的屬性無效。`);
        if(!Number.isFinite(sk.value)||sk.value<0)issues.push(`角色 ${ci} 輔助技能 ${si} 的基礎效果比例必須是非負數。`);
        if(!Number.isFinite(sk.effectPerLevel)||sk.effectPerLevel<0)issues.push(`角色 ${ci} 輔助技能 ${si} 的每級增加倍率必須是非負數。`);
        if(['followup','dotAttack','dotMaxHp','damageAmp'].includes(sk.kind)&&!['enemy','enemies'].includes(sk.target))issues.push(`角色 ${ci} 輔助技能 ${si} 使用傷害型 DEBUFF 時，目標應為 enemy 或 enemies。`);
      }
      return [...new Set(issues)];
    };
  }

  data.notes=[...new Set([...(data.notes||[]),
