function count(section,normalized=false){
  if(!normalized) ensureArrays();
  if(section==="classes") return data.classes.length;
  if(section==="skills") return data.classes.reduce((n,c)=>n+(Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills.length:0),0)+data.supportSkills.reduce((n,a)=>n+(Array.isArray(a)?a.length:0),0);
  if(section==="equipment") return data.equipmentForms.reduce((n,c)=>n+c.reduce((m,s)=>m+(Array.isArray(s)?s.length:0),0),0);
  if(section==="items") return data.items.length;
  if(section==="balanceSettings") return flattenSettingLeaves(data.balanceSettings).length;
  return "";
}
function renderNav(normalized=false){
  if(!normalized)ensureArrays();
  const nav=document.getElementById("nav");
  const scrollTop=nav.scrollTop;
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-nav-group]").forEach(group=>{
    if(group.open)expandedNavGroups.add(group.dataset.navGroup);
    else expandedNavGroups.delete(group.dataset.navGroup);
  });
  const pages=new Map(SECTION_META),assigned=new Set(["overview"]);
  const button=([id,label])=>{
    const n=count(id,true);
    return `
    <button type="button" class="navbtn ${currentSection===id?"active":""}" data-sec="${esc(id)}" ${currentSection===id?'aria-current="page"':""}>
      <span>${esc(label)}</span>${n!==""?`<span class="badge">${esc(n)}</span>`:""}
    </button>`;
  };
  const groups=NAV_GROUPS.map(([id,label,sections])=>({id,label,entries:sections.filter(sec=>pages.has(sec)).map(sec=>{assigned.add(sec);return [sec,pages.get(sec)];})}));
  // Keep future extension pages reachable even before they receive a category.
  groups.find(group=>group.id==="tools").entries.push(...SECTION_META.filter(([id])=>!assigned.has(id)));
  nav.innerHTML=(pages.has("overview")?button(["overview",pages.get("overview")]):"")+groups.map(group=>{
    if(!group.entries.length)return "";
    const active=group.entries.some(([id])=>id===currentSection);
    if(active)expandedNavGroups.add(group.id);
    return `<details class="nav-group ${active?"has-active":""}" data-nav-group="${group.id}" ${expandedNavGroups.has(group.id)?"open":""}>
      <summary><span>${esc(group.label)}</span><span class="nav-group-count">${group.entries.length} 項</span></summary>
      <div class="nav-group-items">${group.entries.map(button).join("")}</div>
    </details>`;
  }).join("");
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-sec]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{currentSection=b.dataset.sec; render();});
  nav.scrollTop=scrollTop;
}
function render(){
  ensureArrays();
  renderNav(true);
  const app=document.getElementById("app");
  const renderers={
    overview:renderOverview,classes:renderClasses,skills:renderSkills,
    equipment:renderEquipment,items:renderItems,balanceSettings:renderBalanceSettings,
    balance:renderBalance,raw:renderRaw
  };
  app.innerHTML="";
  renderers[currentSection]();
}
function sectionHead(title,desc,actions=""){
  return `<div class="section-head"><div><h1>${title}</h1><p>${desc}</p></div><div class="section-actions">${actions}</div></div>`;
}
function card(title,body,extra=""){
  return `<div class="card"><div class="card-h"><strong>${title}</strong>${extra}</div><div class="card-b">${body}</div></div>`;
}
function inputField(label,key,value,type="text",extra="",full=false,help="",readonly=false){
  const id="f_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  return `<div class="field ${full?"full":""}"><label for="${id}">${fieldTitle(label,key,readonly)}</label><input id="${id}" data-key="${esc(key)}" type="${type}" value="${esc(value)}" ${extra} ${readonly?"readonly":""}>${helpText(help)}</div>`;
}
function selectField(label,key,value,opts,full=false,help="",labels=null,disabled=false){
  const id="f_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  const pairs=opts.map(x=>typeof x==="object"?x:{value:x,label:labels?.[x]||x});
  return `<div class="field ${full?"full":""}"><label for="${id}">${fieldTitle(label,key,disabled)}</label><select id="${id}" data-key="${esc(key)}" ${disabled?"disabled":""}>${pairs.map(x=>`<option value="${esc(x.value)}" ${x.value===value?"selected":""}>${esc(x.label)}</option>`).join("")}</select>${helpText(help)}</div>`;
}
function boolField(label,key,value,help=""){
  const id="f_"+Math.random().toS
---
d)ensureArrays();
  const nav=document.getElementById("nav");
  const scrollTop=nav.scrollTop;
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-nav-group]").forEach(group=>{
    if(group.open)expandedNavGroups.add(group.dataset.navGroup);
    else expandedNavGroups.delete(group.dataset.navGroup);
  });
  const pages=new Map(SECTION_META),assigned=new Set(["overview"]);
  const button=([id,label])=>{
    const n=count(id,true);
    return `
    <button type="button" class="navbtn ${currentSection===id?"active":""}" data-sec="${esc(id)}" ${currentSection===id?'aria-current="page"':""}>
      <span>${esc(label)}</span>${n!==""?`<span class="badge">${esc(n)}</span>`:""}
    </button>`;
  };
  const groups=NAV_GROUPS.map(([id,label,sections])=>({id,label,entries:sections.filter(sec=>pages.has(sec)).map(sec=>{assigned.add(sec);return [sec,pages.get(sec)];})}));
  // Keep future extension pages reachable even before they receive a category.
  groups.find(group=>group.id==="tools").entries.push(...SECTION_META.filter(([id])=>!assigned.has(id)));
  nav.innerHTML=(pages.has("overview")?button(["overview",pages.get("overview")]):"")+groups.map(group=>{
    if(!group.entries.length)return "";
    const active=group.entries.some(([id])=>id===currentSection);
    if(active)expandedNavGroups.add(group.id);
    return `<details class="nav-group ${active?"has-active":""}" data-nav-group="${group.id}" ${expandedNavGroups.has(group.id)?"open":""}>
      <summary><span>${esc(group.label)}</span><span class="nav-group-count">${group.entries.length} 項</span></summary>
      <div class="nav-group-items">${group.entries.map(button).join("")}</div>
    </details>`;
  }).join("");
  nav.querySelectorAll("[data-sec]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{currentSection=b.dataset.sec; render();});
  nav.scrollTop=scrollTop;
}

function boolField(label,key,value,help=""){
  const id="f_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  return `<div class="field"><label for="${id}">${fieldTitle(label,key,false)}</label><select id="${id}" data-key="${esc(key)}"><option value="false" ${!value?"selected":""}>否</option><option value="true" ${value?"selected":""}>是</option></select>${helpText(help)}</div>`;

function textareaField(label,key,value,help=""){
  const id="f_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  return `<div class="field full"><label for="${id}">${fieldTitle(label,key,false)}</label><textarea id="${id}" data-key="${esc(key)}">${esc(value)}</textarea>${helpText(help)}</div>`;
}
function bindObjectFields(container,obj){
  container.querySelectorAll("[data-key]").forEach(el=>{
    el.onchange=()=>{
      const k=el.dataset.key;
      if(el.dataset.json==="1"){
        try{obj[k]=JSON.parse(el.value); el.style.borderColor=""; markDirty();}catch{el.style.borderColor="var(--danger)";}
        return;
      }
      if(el.type==="number") obj[k]=el.value===""?0:Number(el.value);
      else if(el.dataset.bool==="1" || (el.tagName==="SELECT" && (el.value==="true"||el.value==="false"))) obj[k]=el.value==="true";
      else obj[k]=el.value;
      markDirty();
    };
  });
}
function confirmDelete(msg){ return window.confirm(msg); }

function renderOverview(){
  const issues=validateData();
  const stats=[
    ["角色",count("classes")],["核心技能",count("skills")],["輔助技能",count("support")],["裝備變體",count("equipment")],
    ["商店道具",count("items")],["平衡設定",count("balanceSettings")],["詞條設定",flattenSettingLeaves(data.balance||{}).length],["地圖門檻",data.balanceSettings?.maps?.levelRanges?.length||0]
  ];
  document.getElementById("app").innerHTML =
    sectionHead("總覽","遊戲中可安全資料化的平衡數值已集中到 balanceSettings；本頁以中文名稱編輯，匯出仍保留遊戲需要的 JSON key。",
      `<button id="validateBtn">檢查相容性</button><button id="resetBtn" class="danger">還原最初資料</button>`) +
    `<div class="statgrid">${stats.map(([l,n])=>`<div class="card stat"><div class="n">${n}</div><div class="l">${l}</div></div>`).join("")}</div>` +
    (issues.length?`<div class="errornotice"><b>與目前 HTML 的匯入規則相比，發現 ${issues.length} 個提醒：</b><br>${issues.map(x=>"• "+esc(x)).join("<br>")}</div>`:`<div class="oknotice">目前結構符合這份 HTML 的主要測試設定匯入規則。</div>`) +
    `<div class="notice"><b>重要：</b>這份 HTML 的測試設定真正會讀取的是 <span class="code">balance / classes / supportSkills / equipmentForms / items</span>。怪物、掉落、強化仍寫死在 HTML 程式中，額外建立同名 JSON 區塊不會改變遊戲。</div>`+
    card("目前檔案",`<div class="fields">
      ${inputField("設定格式版本","schema",data.schema||"","text","",false,"遊戲匯入固定要求 emberwild-balance-v1；修改會直接匯入失敗。",true)}
      <div class="field"><label>頂層區塊</label><input value="${esc(Object.keys(data).join(", "))}" readonly><div class="field-help">只有遊戲程式實際讀取的區塊會產生效果。</div></div>
      <div class="field full"><label>相容性摘要</label><div class="mini-note">角色數固定為 4；每職業輔助技能實際系統固定 3 個；商店元素道具固定 15 筆且 id／type／element 不可改。核心技能與裝備變體可增減，但刪除或改變順序可能使既有存檔的索引對應改變。</div></div>
    </div>`);
  document.getElementById("validateBtn").onclick=()=>render();
  document.getElementById("resetBtn").onclick=()=>{
    if(confirmDelete("確定要放棄目前所有修改，還原成開啟編輯器時的原始 JSON？")){
      data=structuredClone(ORIGINAL_DATA); selected={class:0,skillClass:0,skill:0,supportClass:0,support:0,equipClass:0,equipSlot:0,equip:0,item:0,generic:{monsters:0,drops:0,enhancement:0}};
      markDirty("已還原原始資料，尚未匯出"); render();
    }
  };
}

  return `<div class="list">${data.classes.map((c,i)=>`
    <div class="listitem ${i===active?"active":""}" data-index="${i}">
      <div class="title">${esc(c.name||"(未命名角色)")}</div>
      <div class="sub">角色索引 ${i} · ${esc(c.advanced||"")}</div>
    </div>`).join("") || `<div class="empty">目前沒有角色</div>`}</div>`;
}

  const c=data.classes[selected.class];
  document.getElementById("app").innerHTML =
    sectionHead("角色","HTML 以 classes 陣列索引 0~3 對應四職業；目前版本不能新增或刪除職業，否則匯入會被拒絕。") +

    `<div class="grid2">

      ${c?card("角色資料",`<div class="fields">
        ${inputField("角色 ID（識別用）","id",c.id,"number","step=1",false,"遊戲套用角色時依陣列索引，不使用此 id；建議保持原值。",true)}
        ${inputField("職業名稱","name",c.name||"","text","",false,"角色名稱、裝備職業標示等顯示用。")}
        ${inputField("二轉名稱","advanced",c.advanced||"","text","",false,"只改二轉顯示名稱；LV15、生命+18%、攻擊+22%、防禦+15%及二轉成本仍由 HTML 固定。")}
        ${inputField("主要屬性名稱","main",c.main||"","text","",false,"只改能力點頁面的屬性名稱；第一欄能力點仍固定每點攻擊力 +2。")}
        ${inputField("角色基礎生命","hp",c.hp??0,"number","min=0.0001 step=1",false,"角色 1 級未計裝備與能力點時的基礎生命；必須大於 0。")}
        ${inputField("角色基礎攻擊","atk",c.atk??0,"number","min=0.0001 step=1",false,"角色 1 級未計裝備與能力點時的基礎攻擊；必須大於 0。")}
        ${inputField("角色基礎防禦","def",c.def??0,"number","min=0 step=1",false,"角色 1 級未計裝備與能力點時的基礎防禦；可為 0。")}
        <div class="field"><label>核心技能數</label><input value="${Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills.length:0}" readonly><div class="field-help">技能可增減，但既有存檔以技能索引保存等級與寶石；改順序或刪除會改變對應。</div></div>

    </div>`;
  const app=document.getElementById("app");
  app.querySelectorAll(".listitem[data-index]").forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{selected.class=Number(x.dataset.index);render();});
  if(c) bindObjectFields(app,c);
}


const SKILL_USAGE_SCOPES=["character","monster","elite","boss","shared"];
const SKILL_USAGE_SCOPE_LABELS={character:"人物",monster:"怪物",elite:"菁英",boss:"BOSS",shared:"共用"};
function normalizeSkillUsageScope(sk){
  if(!sk||typeof sk!=="object")return "character";
  sk.usageScope=SKILL_USAGE_SCOPES.includes(sk.usageScope)?sk.usageScope:"character";
  return sk.usageScope;
}
function uniqueCoreSkillId(job){
  const ids=new Set((data.classes||[]).flatMap(c=>(c.skills||[]).map(sk=>sk?.id).filter(Boolean)));
  let n=(data.classes?.[job]?.skills||[]).length,id='job'+job+'-skill'+n;
  while(ids.has(id))id='job'+job+'-skill'+(++n);
  return id;
}
function removeMonsterSkillReferences(skillId){
  if(!skillId)return;
  for(const m of data.balanceSettings?.monsters?.catalog||[])m.skillAssignments=(m.skillAssignments||[]).filter(a=>a?.skillId!==skillId);
}
function skillWorkspaceToolbar(activeTab){
  const tabs=[["active","主動技能"],["proc","普攻觸發技能"],["support","輔助技能"],...(companionSkillOwner()?[["passive","被動技能"]]:[])];
  const scope=activeTab==="support"?"":'<label style="margin:0">用途</label><select id="skillScopeFilter"><option value="all" '+(selected.skillScopeFilter==="all"?"selected":"")+'>全部</option>'+SKILL_USAGE_SCOPES.map(v=>'<option value="'+v+'" '+(selected.skillScopeFilter===v?"selected":"")+'>'+SKILL_USAGE_SCOPE_LABELS[v]+'</option>').join("")+'</select>';
  if(companionSkillOwner())return '<div class="toolbar skill-workspace-toolbar"><div class="tabs">'+tabs.map(([id,label])=>'<button type="button" class="'+(activeTab===id?'primary':'')+'" data-skill-tab="'+id+'">'+label+'</button>').join('')+'</div></div>';
  return '<div class="toolbar skill-workspace-toolbar"><label style="margin:0">角色</label><select id="skillClassSel">'+
    data.classes.map((x,i)=>'<option value="'+i+'" '+(i===selected.skillClass?'selected':'')+'>'+esc(x.name
---

  const tabs=[["active","主動技能"],["proc","普攻觸發技能"],["support","輔助技能"],...(companionSkillOwner()?[["passive","被動技能"]]:[])];
  const scope=activeTab==="support"?"":'<label style="margin:0">用途</label><select id="skillScopeFilter"><option value="all" '+(selected.skillScopeFilter==="all"?"selected":"")+'>全部</option>'+SKILL_USAGE_SCOPES.map(v=>'<option value="'+v+'" '+(selected.skillScopeFilter===v?"selected":"")+'>'+SKILL_USAGE_SCOPE_LABELS[v]+'</option>').join("")+'</select>';
  if(companionSkillOwner())return '<div class="toolbar skill-workspace-toolbar"><div class="tabs">'+tabs.map(([id,label])=>'<button type="button" class="'+(activeTab===id?'primary':'')+'" data-skill-tab="'+id+'">'+label+'</button>').join('')+'</div></div>';
  return '<div class="toolbar skill-workspace-toolbar"><label style="margin:0">角色</label><select id="skillClassSel">'+
    data.classes.map((x,i)=>'<option value="'+i+'" '+(i===selected.skillClass?'selected':'')+'>'+esc(x.name)+'</option>').join('')+
    '</select>'+scope+'<div class="tabs">'+tabs.map(([id,label])=>'<button type="button" class="'+(activeTab===id?'primary':'')+'" data-skill-tab="'+id+'">'+label+'</button>').join('')+'</div></div>';
}
function bindSkillWorkspaceToolbar(){
  const sel=document.getElementById("skillClassSel");
  if(sel)sel.onchange=()=>{selected.skillClass=Number(sel.value);selected.supportClass=selected.skillClass;selected.skill=0;selected.support=0;render();};
  const scope=document.getElementById("skillScopeFilter");
  if(scope)scope.onchange=()=>{selected.skillScopeFilter=scope.value;selected.skill=-1;render();};
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-skill-tab]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{selected.skillTab=b.dataset.skillTab;selected.supportClass=selected.skillClass;selected.skill=0;selected.support=0;render();});
}

function renderSkills(){
  ensureArrays();
  selected.skillTab=["active","proc","support"].includes(selected.skillTab)?selected.skillTab:"active";
  selected.skillScopeFilter=["all",...SKILL_USAGE_SCOPES].includes(selected.skillScopeFilter)?selected.skillScopeFilter:"all";
  selected.skillClass=Math.min(selected.skillClass,Math.max(0,data.classes.length-1));
  selected.supportClass=selected.skillClass;

  if(selected.skillTab==="support"){
    renderSupport();
    const app=document.getElementById("app"),head=app.querySelector(".section-head"),oldToolbar=app.querySelector(".toolbar");
    if(head){
      const title=head.querySelector("h1"),desc=head.querySelector("p");
      if(title)title.textContent="主角技能";
      if(desc)desc.textContent="人物用途的技能僅供主角使用；怪物用途依原用途分類配置。夥伴技能在各自的專屬技能頁設計。";
    }
    if(oldToolbar)oldToolbar.remove();
    if(head)head.insertAdjacentHTML("afterend",skillWorkspaceToolbar("support"));
    bindSkillWorkspaceToolbar();
    return;
  }

  const skillMode=selected.skillTab,c=data.classes[selected.skillClass];
  const skills=c&&Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills:(c?(c.skills=[]):[]);
  const visible=skills.map((sk,i)=>({sk,i})).filter(x=>x.sk.activation===skillMode&&companionSkillVisible(x.sk)&&(selected.skillScopeFilter==="all"||normalizeSkillUsageScope(x.sk)===selected.skillScopeFilter));
  if(!visible.some(x=>x.i===selected.skill))selected.skill=visible.length?visible[0].i:-1;
  const sk=selected.skill>=0?skills[selected.skill]:null;
  if(sk)ensureProcSkillFields(sk);
  const procOnly=sk&&PROC_ONLY_EFFECTS.has(sk.effect),effectOptions=skillMode==="proc"?EFFECTS:EFFECTS.filter(x=>!PROC_ONLY_EFFECTS.has(x));
  const effectHelp=skillMode==="proc"?"proc 可使用一般傷害／治療／護盾／吸血，或三種觸發專屬效果。觸發專屬效果不能配置給 active 技能。":"active 技能可使用傷害、治療、護盾、吸血、淨化、驅散、復活及既有控制效果。";
  const powerHelp=sk?.effect==="nextActiveDamage"?"0.25 = 基礎 +25% 下次主動技能傷害；技能等級、寶石與指定技能效果詞條仍會放大此比例。":sk?.effect==="advanceNextRound"?"此效果固定前移 1 格，不使用 power；保留欄位只為 JSON 結構相容。":sk?.effect==="shieldLowest"?"以施放者攻擊力為基準；0.8 = 產生攻擊力 80% 的純護盾，給生命比例最低的存活隊友。":'最終技能量先以「角色攻擊力 × 此倍率」為基礎，再乘技能等級、寶石、指定技能效果詞條與輔助技能 power。1 = 100% 攻擊力。';

  document.getElementById("app").innerHTML =
    sectionHead("主角技能","人物用途的技能僅供主角使用；怪物用途依原用途分類配置。夥伴技能在各自的專屬技能頁設計。",
      '<button id="addSkill" '+(c?"":"disabled")+'>新增'+(skillMode==="proc"?"觸發":"主動")+'技能</button>'+(sk?'<button id="dupSkill">複製技能</button><button id="delSkill" class="danger">刪除技能</button>':""))+
    '<div class="notice">主動技能與普攻觸發技能仍共用 classes[].skills 陣列索引；「用途分類」決定人物或哪類怪物可使用同一技能定義。既有存檔以索引保存技能等級與寶石，正式資料請避免任意重排。</div>'+
    skillWorkspaceToolbar(skillMode)+
    '<div class="grid2"><div class="card"><div class="list">'+
      (visible.map(({sk:x,i})=>'<div class="listitem '+(i===selected.skill?"active":"")+'" data-skill="'+i+'"><div class="title">'+esc(x.name||"(未命名技能)")+'</div><div class="sub">'+esc(SKILL_USAGE_SCOPE_LABELS[normalizeSkillUsageScope(x)]||"人物")+' · '+esc(ACTIVATION_LABELS[x.activation]||x.activation)+' · '+esc(EFFECT_LABELS[x.effect]||x.effect)+' · LV.'+esc(x.requiredLevel)+'</div></div>').join("")||'<div class="empty">此分頁目前沒有技能，可直接新增。</div>')+
    '</div></div>'+
    (sk?card("技能資料",'<div class="fields">'+
      inputField("技能 ID（共用識別）","id",sk.id||"","text","",false,"怪物技能指派會直接引用此 ID。建立後應保持穩定，且所有核心技能之間不可重複。",true)+
      inputField("技能名稱","name",sk.name||"","text","",false,"戰鬥紀錄與技能頁顯示名稱。")+
      selectField("用途分類","usageScope",normalizeSkillUsageScope(sk),SKILL_USAGE_SCOPES,false,"人物：只供角色使用；怪物：普通怪；菁英：菁英怪；BOSS：地圖 BOSS 與終局首領；共用：人物與所有怪物皆可使用。",SKILL_USAGE_SCOPE_LABELS)+
      selectField("發動方式","activation",sk.activation||skillMod
---
_ONLY_EFFECTS.has(sk.effect))sk.effect="damage";selected.skillTab=sk.activation;const owner=companionSkillOwner();if(owner){owner.active=owner.active.filter(i=>i!==selected.skill);owner.proc=owner.proc.filter(i=>i!==selected.skill);owner[sk.activation==='proc'?'proc':'active'].push(selected.skill);}markDirty();render();};
    const effect=app.querySelector('[data-key="effect"]');
    if(effect)effect.onchange=()=>{sk.effect=effect.value;markDirty();render();};
  }
  const add=document.getElementById("addSkill");
  if(add)add.onclick=()=>{
    if(!c)return;
    const next={id:uniqueCoreSkillId(selected.skillClass),name:"新技能",usageScope:"character",activation:skillMode,requiredLevel:1,cooldown:skillMode==="active"?3:0,power:1,powerPerLevel:data.balanceSettings?.skills?.core?.effectPerExtraLevel??.18,effect:"damage",element:"physical",maxTargets:1,requiresAdvanced:false,iconType:"auto",description:""};
    if(skillMode==="proc")ensureProcSkillFields(next);
    assignCompanionSkill(next,"core",skills.length);skills.push(next);selected.skill=skills.length-1;markDirty();render();
  };
  if(sk){
    document.getElementById("dupSkill").onclick=()=>{const copy=structuredClone(sk);copy.id=uniqueCoreSkillId(selected.skillClass);copy.name=(copy.name||"技能")+" 複製";assignCompanionSkill(copy,"core",skills.length);skills.push(copy);selected.skill=skills.length-1;markDirty();render();};
    document.getElementById("delSkill").onclick=()=>{if(skills.length<=1)return alert("遊戲匯入規則要求每個職業至少保留 1 個核心技能。");if(confirmDelete('刪除技能「'+sk.name+'」？既有存檔後方技能索引會前移；引用此技能的怪物指派也會一併移除。')){const removed=selected.skill,removedId=sk.id;remapCompanionSkillRemoval(selected.skillClass,"core",removed);skills.splice(removed,1);removeMonsterSkillReferences(removedId);selected.skill=-1;markDirty();render();}};
  }
}
function renderSupport(){
  selected.supportClass=Math.min(selected.supportClass,Math.max(0,data.classes.length-1));
  const group=data.supportSkills[selected.supportClass] || [];
  selected.support=Math.min(selected.support,Math.max(0,group.length-1));
  const visible=group.map((sk,i)=>({sk,i})).filter(x=>companionSkillVisible(x.sk));if(!visible.some(x=>x.i===selected.support))selected.support=visible[0]?.i??-1;
  const sk=group[selected.support], c=data.classes[selected.supportClass];
  document.getElementById("app").innerHTML =
    sectionHead("輔助技能","實際遊戲的 supportLevels 固定 3 格、supportSlots 只允許索引 0~2，因此每職業固定三個輔助技能；這裡只允許修改內容，不提供增刪。")+
    `<div class="notice">每級輔助技能會把基礎效果乘上 1 + (技能等級−1)×20%；最高 5 級。第 3 個輔助技能（索引 2）在 HTML 中額外寫死為需要二轉。</div><div class="oknotice">計時已統一：持續時間＝全隊戰鬥回合；冷卻＝施放者自身行動回合。所有數值都可在本頁直接調整。</div>`+
    `<div class="toolbar"><label style="margin:0">角色</label><select id="supportClassSel">${data.classes.map((x,i)=>`<option value="${i}" ${i===selected.supportClass?"selected":""}>${esc(x.name)}</option>`).join("")}</select></div>`+
    `<div class="grid2"><div class="card"><div class="list">${group.map((x,i)=>companionSkillVisible(x)?`<div class="listitem ${i===selected.support?"active":""}" data-support="${i}"><div class="title">${esc(x.name||"(未命名)")}</div><div class="sub">${esc(SUPPORT_KIND_LABELS[x.kind]||x.kind)} · ${esc(SUPPORT_TARGET_LABELS[x.target]||x.target)} · 需求 LV.${esc(x.level)}</div></div>`:'').join("")||`<div class="empty">缺少輔助技能資料</div>`}</div></div>`+
    (sk?card("輔助技能資料",`<div class="fields">
      ${inputField("技能 ID（識別用）","id",sk.id||"","text","",false,"套用時會移除 id，執行階段以陣列索引識別；建議保持原值。",true)}
      ${inputField("技能名稱","name",sk.name||"","text","",false,"技能頁與戰鬥紀錄顯示名稱。")}
      ${selectField("作用目標","target",sk.target||"allies",SUPPORT_TARGETS,false,"決定效果套用對象。敵方單體固定目前集火目標。",SUPPORT_TARGET_LABELS)}
      ${selectField("效果類型","kind",sk.kind||"attack",SUPPORT_KINDS,false,"效果會在戰鬥中的 effects 系統累加；同來源同技能對同目標會刷新時間，不重複疊加。",SUPPORT_KIND_LABELS)}
      ${selectField("技能屬性標示","element",sk.element||"physical",ELEMENTS,false,"目前輔助技能的 element 主要用於介面標示，實際 buff/debuff 強度不做元素剋制計算。",ELEMENT_LABELS)}
      ${inputField("基礎效果比例","value",sk.value??0,"number","min=0 step=0.001",false,`使用 0~1 小數，例如 0.18 = 18%。目前值約 ${percentPreview(sk.value)}；技能升級每級再增加基礎效果的 20%。`)}
      ${inputField("持續時間（戰鬥回合）","duration",sk.duration??0,"number","min=0 step=1",false,"BUFF／DEBUFF 以全隊戰鬥回合計時；暫停、對話框時不推進。regen 在持續期間每戰鬥回合按最大生命比例回復。")}
      ${inputField("冷卻時間（自身行動回合）","cooldown",sk.cooldown??0,"number","min=0 step=1",false,"只有施放者自己的行動回合會扣除冷卻；其他角色、敵人與戰鬥倍速都不會額外推進。")}
      ${inputField("需求等級","level",sk.level??1,"number","min=1 step=1",false,"達到此角色等級後才能學習；索引 2 的第三個輔助技能另外固定要求二轉。")}
      ${textareaField("技能風味說明","description",sk.description||"","完全手寫，只負責顯示文字，不參與效果計算。")}
    </div>`):card("輔助技能資料",`<div class="empty">每個職業應有 3 個輔助技能；目前 JSON 結構不完整。</div>`))+`</div>`;
  const app=document.getElementById("app");
  const sel=document.getElementById("supportClassSel"); if(sel) sel.onchange=()=>{selected.supportClass=Number(sel.value);selected.support=0;render();};
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-support]").forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{selected.support=Number(x.dataset.support);render();});
  if(sk){bindObjectFields(app,sk);}
}

function renderEquipment(){
  selected.equipClass=Math.min(selected.equipClass,Math.max(0,data.classes.length));
  const isGlobalClass=selected.equipClass===data.classes.length;
  const c=isGlobalClass?{name:"全職業"}:data.classes[selected.equipClass];
  const classSlots=data.equipmentForms[selected.equipClass] || [[],[],[],[]];
  const slot=classSlots[selected.equipSlot] || [];
  selected.equip=Math.min(selected.equip,Math.max(0,slot.length-1));
  const e=slot[selected.equip];
  const wearableJobs=e&&Array.isArray(e.wearableJobs)?e.wearableJobs:[];
  const allJobsSelected=!!e&&wearableJobs.length===data.classes.length;
  document.getElementById("app").innerHTML =
    sectionHead("裝備變體","對應 equipmentForms。職業裝備分為武器、護甲、副手、飾品 4 類；另可在「全職業」類別建立共用基底。",
      `<button id="addEquip" ${c?"":"disabled"}>新增裝備變體</button>${e?`<button id="dupEquip">複製變體</button><button id="delEquip" class="danger" ${!isGlobalClass&&slot.length<=1?"disabled":""}>刪除變體</button>`:""}`)+
    `<div class="notice">裝備變體索引會存進既有裝備的 <span class="code">form</span>。刪除或重排變體，可能讓舊存檔中的既有裝備改成另一個外型／專屬效果。</div>`+
    `<div class="toolbar"><label style="margin:0">類別</label><select id="equipClassSel">${data.classes.map((x,i)=>`<option value="${i}" ${i===selected.equipClass?"selected":""}>${esc(x.name)}</option>`).join("")}<option value="${data.classes.length}" ${isGlobalClass?"selected":""}>全職業</option></select>
      <div class="tabs">${SLOT_NAMES.map((n,i)=>`<button class="${i===selected.equipSlot?"primary":""}" data-slot="${i}">${n}</button>`).join("")}</div></div>`+
    `<div class="grid2"><div class="card"><div class="list">${slot.map((x,i)=>`<div class="listitem ${i===selected.equip?"active":""}" data-equip="${i}"><div class="title">${esc(x.name||"(未命名裝備)")}</div><div class="sub">變體 ${i+1}${x.element?" · "+esc(ELEMENT_LABELS[x.element]||x.element):""}</div></div>`).join("")||`<div class="empty">${isGlobalClass?"尚未建立此類全職業裝備。":"此部位不能為空，否則遊戲匯入會失敗。"}</div>`}</div></div>`+
    (e?card("裝備資料",`<div class="fields">
      ${inputField("裝備 ID（識別用）","id",e.id||"","text","",false,"套用到遊戲時會移除 id；實際裝備變體依職業／部位／陣列索引對應。",true)}
      ${inputField("裝備變體名稱","name",e.name||"","text","",false,"取代該職業該部位的基礎裝備名稱顯示。")}
      <div class="field full"><label>可穿戴職業</label><div class="identity-slots equipment-wearable-jobs"><label><input id="equipWearAll" type="checkbox" ${allJobsSelected?"checked":""}>全職業</label>${data.classes.map((x,i)=>`<label><input type="checkbox" data-wearable-job="${i}" ${wearableJobs.includes(i)?"checked":""}>${esc(x.name)}</label>`).join("")}</div><div class="field-help">逐件設定可穿戴職業；勾選「全職業」會一次選取全部職業。至少保留 1 個可穿戴職業。</div></div>
      <div class="field full"><label>${fieldTitle("固定屬性","fixedEffects",false)}</label><div class="field-help" style="margin-bottom:8px">每件裝備固定 1～5 條屬性。現在先開放所有裝備相關屬性，不限制武器／護甲／副手／飾品可選範圍；後續可再加入部位限制。</div><div id="fixedEffectRows"></div><button id="addFixedEffect" class="small">新增固定屬性</button></div>
    </div>`):card("裝備資料",`<div class="empty">請新增或選擇裝備</div>`))+`</div>`;
  const app=document.getElementById("app");
  const csel=document.getElementById("equipClassSel"); if(csel)csel.onchange=()=>{selected.equipClass=Number(csel.value);selected.equip=0;render();};
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-slot]").forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{selected.equipSlot=Number(x.dataset.slot);selected.equip=0;render();});
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-equip]").forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{selected.equip=Number(x.dataset.equip);render();});
  if(e){
    bindObjectFields(app,e);
    normalizeEquipmentFixedEffects(e);
    const wearAll=app.querySelector("#equipWearAll");
    if(wearAll)wearAll.onchange=(
---
;
    };
    app.querySelectorAll("[data-wearable-job]").forEach(el=>el.onchange=()=>{
      const job=Number(el.dataset.wearableJob),current=new Set(Array.isArray(e.wearableJobs)?e.wearableJobs:[]);
      if(el.checked)current.add(job);else current.delete(job);
      if(!current.size){el.checked=true;return alert("至少保留 1 個可穿戴職業。");}
      e.wearableJobs=[...current].filter(j=>Number.isInteger(j)&&j>=0&&j<data.classes.length).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
      markDirty();renderEquipment();
    });
    renderFixedEffectRows(e);
    document.getElementById("addFixedEffect").onclick=()=>{
      if(e.fixedEffects.length>=5)return alert("每件裝備最多 5 條固定屬性。");
      e.fixedEffects.push({key:"flatAttack",value:0});markDirty();renderEquipment();
    };
  }
  document.getElementById("addEquip").onclick=()=>{
    if(!c)return; const i=slot.length,allJobs=data.classes.map((_,job)=>job),prefix=isGlobalClass?"all":`job${selected.equipClass}`;
    slot.push({id:`${prefix}-slot${selected.equipSlot}-form${i}`,name:"新裝備",wearableJobs:isGlobalClass||selected.equipSlot===1?allJobs:[selected.equipClass],fixedEffects:[{key:"flatAttack",value:0}]});
    selected.equip=slot.length-1;markDirty();render();
  };
  if(e){
    document.getElementById("dupEquip").onclick=()=>{const copy=structuredClone(e),prefix=isGlobalClass?"all":`job${selected.equipClass}`;copy.id=`${prefix}-slot${selected.equipSlot}-form${slot.length}`;copy.name=(copy.name||"裝備")+" 複製";slot.push(copy);selected.equip=slot.length-1;markDirty();render();};
    document.getElementById("delEquip").onclick=()=>{if(!isGlobalClass&&slot.length<=1)return alert("每個職業的每個部位至少必須保留 1 種裝備變體。");if(confirmDelete(`刪除裝備「${e.name}」？既有存檔的 form 索引可能因此改變。`)){slot.splice(selected.equip,1);selected.equip=Math.max(0,selected.equip-1);markDirty();render();}};
  }
}

function renderFixedEffectRows(e){
  normalizeEquipmentFixedEffects(e);
  const host=document.getElementById("fixedEffectRows");
  const skillCount=equipmentFixedSkillCount(e);
  host.innerHTML=e.fixedEffects.map((fx,i)=>{
    const def=EQUIPMENT_FIXED_EFFECT_BY_KEY[fx.key]||EQUIPMENT_FIXED_EFFECT_DEFS[0];
    const skillOptions=Array.from({length:skillCount},(_,skill)=>`<option value="${skill}" ${Number(fx.skill)===skill?"selected":""}>${esc(equipmentFixedSkillLabel(e,skill))}</option>`).join("")+(Number.isInteger(fx.skill)&&fx.skill>=skillCount?`<option value="${fx.skill}" selected>核心技能 ${fx.skill+1}（目前不存在）</option>`:"");
    const target=def.target==="element"?`<select class="fixed-target">${ELEMENTS.filter(x=>x!=="physical").map(x=>`<option value="${x}" ${fx.element===x?"selected":""}>${esc(ELEMENT_LABELS[x]||x)}</option>`).join("")}</select>`:def.target==="race"?`<select class="fixed-target">${Object.entries(EQUIPMENT_FIXED_RACES).map(([k,n])=>`<option value="${k}" ${fx.race===k?"selected":""}>${n}</option>`).join("")}</select>`:def.target==="skill"?`<select class="fixed-target">${skillOptions}</select>`:`<span class="fixed-target-placeholder"></span>`;
    const value=fx.key==="basicElement"?`<select class="fixed-value">${ELEMENTS.map(x=>`<option value="${x}" ${fx.value===x?"selected":""}>${esc(ELEMENT_LABELS[x]||x)}</option>`).join("")}</select>`:`<input class="fixed-value" type="number" step="${["basicAdvanceNextRound","allCooldownReduction","skillCooldownReduction"].includes(fx.key)?"1":"0.01"}" value="${esc(fx.value)}">`;
    return `<div class="kvrow fixed-effect-row" data-i="${i}"><select class="fixed-key">${EQUIPMENT_FIXED_EFFECT_DEFS.map(x=>`<option value="${x.key}" ${x.key===fx.key?"selected":""}>${esc(x.label)}</option>`).join("")}</select>${target}${value}<span class="pill">${esc(def.unit)}</span><button class="small danger fixed-del" ${e.fixedEffects.length<=1?"disabled":""}>×</button><div class="field-help" style="grid-column:1/-1">${esc(def.help)} <span class="field-key">JSON：fixedEffects[${i}].${esc(fx.key)}</span></div></div>`;
  }).join("");
  host.querySelectorAll(".fixed-effect-row").forEach(row=>{
    const i=Number(row.dataset.i),fx=e.fixedEffects[i],keySel=row.querySelector(".fixed-key"),target=row.querySelector(".fixed-target"),value=row.querySelector(".fixed-value");
    keySel.onchange=()=>{fx.key=keySel.value;fx.value=fixedEffectDefault(fx.key);delete fx.element;delete fx.race;delete fx.skill;const def=EQUIPMENT_FIXED_EFFECT_BY_KEY[fx.key];if(def?.target==="element")fx.element="fire";if(def?.target==="race")fx.race="beast";if(def?.target==="skill")fx.skill=0;markDirty();renderEquipment();};
    if(target)target.onchange=()=>{const def=EQUIPMENT_FIXED_EFFECT_BY_KEY[fx.key];if(def?.target==="element")fx.element=target.value;else if(def?.target==="race")fx.race=target.value;else if(def?.target==="skill")fx.skill=Number(target.value);markDirty();};
    value.onchange=()=>{fx.value=fx.key==="basicElement"?value.value:Number(value.value);markDirty();};
    row.querySelector(".fixed-del").onclick=()=>{if(e.fixedEffects.length<=1)return;e.fixedEffects.splice(i,1);markDirty();renderEquipment();};
  });
}

function renderItems(){
  selected.item=Math.min(selected.item,Math.max(0,data.items.length-1));
  const item=data.items[selected.item];
  document.getElementById("app").innerHTML =
    sectionHead("商店消耗道具","目前 HTML 固定要求 15 個元素補給品，且每筆 id / type / element 必須和內建結構完全一致；可修改名稱、價格、持續時間與手寫說明。")+
    `<div class="notice">實際效果強度目前仍寫死在 HTML：附魔＝普通攻擊改成指定屬性；抗性＝對指定屬性傷害減少 25%；增幅＝指定屬性傷害增加 20%。修改 description 不會改變效果。</div>`+
